stories.title: Court denies bail to 14 in Ganga Iftar case:Says, 'Act during Aarti was planned, terms it serious crime'
stories.summary: The bail petition of 14 accused who held an Iftar party on the Ganga river after hijacking a boat and kidnapping a boatman in Varanasi has been rejected. The 14 accused appeared in court today. Arguments continued from 11:30 AM to 1:30 PM in the court of session Judge Alok Kumar. Both sides presented their arguments. The court heard everyone. After that, the court pronounced a 6-page order, in which the bail petitions of all the accused were rejected. Nityanand Rai, advocate for the boatman's said, “This is a great victory for us. This act was done deliberately. These people are not children. The most important thing is that the ghat where they did this was Pachhanga Ghat. And it was the time of Ganga Aarti. Worship was going on everywhere. In such a situation, committing such an act in the middle of the stream is a serious crime.” It may be noted that the District Judge heard the bail application filed on behalf of the accused. For the past three days, dates were being given for their petition. Now the court had summoned all 14 accused to the dock today. In the court of District Judge Sanjeev Shukla, 14 accused imprisoned in jail - Azad, Aamir, Danish, Mo. Ahmed, Nehal, Mahfooz, Anas, Awwal, Tahseem, Mo. Ahmed, Noor Ismail, Tausif, Faizan and Sameer were asked to appear with their lawyer regarding the crime. Picture of Iftar party sitting in a boat First understand entire matter It should be noted that on Monday (16 March) in Kashi, an iftar party was held on a boat in the middle of the Ganga river. In this, the organizers served chicken biryani along with fruits and dry fruits to those observing the fast. A video of the iftar party was made and uploaded on social media. When the video started being shared on social media, it caught the attention of Hindutva organizations. As soon as the mention of chicken biryani came to light in the video, BJP and Hindutva organizations were enraged. Rajat Jaiswal, city president of Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha, filed a case at police station. Within 8 hours of this, police arrested 14 people. All the youth who served biryani during the iftar party on the boat are residents of Tadtalla in the Madanpura area. All belong to the same family. There are several youth from a household famous by the name of Babu Bidi Wale. Among them, Mohammad Awwal, Mohammad Sameer, Mohammad Ahmed, Noor Islam and Mohammad Faizan are residents of the same house. Along with all these, Azad Ali, Mohammad Tahseem, Mahfooz Alam and Nehal Afridi from the same house, as well as Mohammad Ahmad, Mohammad Tausif, Aamir Kaifi, Mohammad Anas and Danish Saifi had reached the ghat. Then an iftar party was held in the boat. All of them are between 19 to 25 years of age. Police made new revelation in court Police told the court against the roza observers that the roza observers kidnapped the boatman. Then they hijacked the boat and held an iftar party. The youths had threatened the boatman and made him sail the boat in the middle of the Ganga. The boatman tried to stop them during the party too, but the youths did not listen to him. Besides this, the purpose of making photos and videos of this iftar party was to send a new message not just to Banaras, but to the country and the world. Before this, such a roza iftar had never been done in Kashi. In the middle of the video reel, the mosque was shown and then the Ganga was shot. After this, the spread laid out on the boat was shot from multiple angles. Separate videos were made of the biryani, and there were also statements about showing oneself as powerful. New twist with threat to advocate The noose has tightened further on the youth arrested for allegedly holding an iftar party on a barge (large boat) and throwing chicken biryani leftovers into the Ganges. Advocate Shashank Shekhar Tripathi, representing the main complainant and BJP Yuva Morcha city president Rajat Jaiswal, has alleged receiving death threats. According to the advocate, on the evening of March 19, when he reached the premises after arguing in court, 5-6 unknown youth were plotting to kill Rajat Jaiswal. When the advocate objected to this, the accused threatened him as well, warning him to face consequences and threatening to kill him. Today, Shashank Shekhar also attempted to seek remand in his case. Petition of the accused dismissed Advocate Nityanand Rai stated - In the court of Session Judge Alok Kumar, arguments continued for two hours in the morning. Both sides presented their respective arguments. The court heard everyone. After that, a 6-page order was pronounced. The court has rejected the bail petitions of all 14 accused. This is a great victory for us. The court has considered this crime as serious. In this, the statement of both boatmen is that we had refused to take 14 people in the boat for carrying mutton-chicken, but those people did not agree. They all forcibly took us to the middle stream of Ganga ji against our will. Hindu religious sentiments were hurt. Those people were trying their best to deepen the issue. The court said - This act was done deliberately. These people are not children. The most important thing is that the ghat where those people did this was Pachhanga Ghat. And it was the time of Ganga Aarti. Worship was going on at various places. In such a situation, doing such an act in the middle stream is a serious crime.

stories.title: Face fate of Varanasi-South changed with ₹10,000 crores:MLA Neelkanth Tiwari says, 'A new hospital will be built with ₹400 cr'
stories.summary: In Kashi's Southern Assembly constituency, there are the numerous abodes of different Gods and Godesses of Baba Vishwanath, Maa Annapurna Temple, Maa Vishalakshi Devi, Mokshdwar Manikarnika Ghat, Asht Bhairav including Kaal Bhairav, and Asht Vinayak temples. Its expanse stretches from Assi Ghat along the Ganga to Dashashwamedh Ghat, Panchganga Ghat, and Namo Ghat. Former minister and Southern MLA Dr. Neelkanth Tiwari says, 'MP from here and PM Modi have given projects worth over ₹10,000 crore to this region in the last 11 years. It has the densest population, and 3 lakh tourists visit this area daily. The biggest project, the Kashi Vishwanath Corridor, worth ₹1200 cr, is its biggest identity here. According to the MLA, the appearance of the streets has changed in the last 9 years of tenure, big projects like Dalmandi and Kaal Bhairav Corridor are taking shape, and many big projects are in the pipeline. The MLA claimed that a new hospital would be built with ₹400 cr. He discussed his role and contribution over 4 years with an interview with Dainik Bhaskar. Here are some excerpts from the conversation Question: What are the major achievements in Southern Assembly constituency in the last 4 years? Answer: Inspired by the Prime Minister, projects worth over ₹10,000 crore have been completed in the Southern Assembly constituency in the last 9 years. The Shri Vishwanath Dham Corridor alone was built for ₹1,200-1,300 crore. Purification of Mother Ganga, the old Shahi Nala, STP, and schemes for all-round development were formulated in every sector. The Southern Assembly constituency used to have problems with sewage, water, and drinking water, which are no longer present. Beautification work of the streets has been done. Approximately 135 small and large tube wells were installed. In the Southern Assembly constituency, there are three underground parking facilities: one or two underground parkings and one multi-story parking. Benia's underground parking has a capacity of 1,600 vehicles, and Town Hall's underground parking has a capacity of 300. The roads are state-of-the-art and of high quality. 22 parks have been beautified in our Southern Assembly constituency. Two-three parks are still left, work will begin this week. 12 primary and council schools in urban areas became smart schools. Rajghat became a smart school. Along with this, Junior High School Kabirchaura, both schools in Durgakund, and other schools that existed, all school buildings were constructed. Today, students, especially young children, face no obstruction in their studies at these schools. Question: What are the projects that promoted religion and tourism in 9 years? Answer: The southern part of Kashi is a center of deities, temples, and spiritual sites. In this area, the routes to reach Nav Devi, Nav Gauri, Asht Bhairav, Asht Pradhan Vinayak, Asht Vinayak, Dwadash Aditya, and Dwadash Jyotirlinga were beautified. All deities, Char Dham, and the ten Mahavidya Peeths were beautified. The pond near Lat Bhairav Temple was beautified. We have about nine such large ponds here. All the ponds were beautified and given a new form, which is a spiritual form, and Lat Bhairav attracts thousands of people. Omkareshwar Mahadev Temple had collapsed, it had completely burst, it was on the verge of falling, but today its magnificent construction has been completed. There are a large number of ghats in the Southern Assembly constituency, and all those ghats were broken. The ghats have been beautified and the world-class Namo Ghat has been constructed. There are a large number of music gharanas (schools/traditions) in the Piplani Katra area and other areas. Their identity was ensured in these music gharanas, and work was done to establish their identity, thus creating a heritage walk. Question: What steps were taken for health services, was any major hospital built? Answer: The biggest project in the medical field, Shri Shivprasad Gupta Divisional Hospital, is going to become a world-class hospital. The tender for that hospital, costing 400 crores, has been finalized, and this time the foundation stone will also be laid by PM Modi. The hospital will reduce the burden on BHU. A multi-specialty, super-specialty, multi-story hospital is going to be built. All existing buildings will be dismantled to create a large hospital with a capacity of 500 beds. It will include 100 ICUs, HDUs, and all types of medical facilities will be provided there. During our tenure, the MCH (Maternal and Child Health) wing has been built in the women's hospital, and the foundation stone for the NICU (Neonatal Intensive Care Unit) is going to be laid. NICUs are going to be established in government hospitals. 5 Urban PHCs (Primary Health Centers) were moved from rented premises to their own buildings. Question: Many projects, including the ropeway, are visible, is any new project also in waiting? Answer: The ropeway project in the Southern Assembly constituency is nearing completion, which will provide access to Vishwanath Dham. The construction of a view bridge across the Ganga, and a plan for an elevated bridge from Namo Ghat to the Ring Road are underway. A Unity Mall is being built in Kazakpura, which will be completed soon. A world-class badminton court is being constructed in Durgakund. A digital library is being built in every ward. We are making many efforts with the MLA's fund. The Konia Ghat bridge was built, and people connected to this side. The construction of the Kazakpura overbridge has resolved Varanasi's traffic problem. We have Antargrihi Parikramas here; there are three Antargrihi Parikramas in Kashi. Thousands of South Indians, from all corners of the country, come to perform the Antargrihi Parikrama. More than 38 crore rupees were provided for treatment from the Chief Minister's Discretionary Fund. All spiritual sites have been beautified. Today, I go and humbly ask everyone that if it seems that any work is still left undone in the Southern Assembly constituency, then please definitely tell us about that work, because we are continuously committed to completing all the remaining tasks. Question: What is the action plan for the next 5 years for the projects that could not be brought this time? Answer: The Southern Assembly constituency's chowk area struggles with traffic jams and crowds. There is a plan in mind to provide access to these devotees and bring them directly to Vishwanath Dham from across the Mother Ganga. We will remove the congestion of Banaras. 5,000 vehicles will be parked across the Ganga, and people will directly cross the Ganga via a bridge and come straight to Vishwanath Dham. From Rajghat to Ramnagar, we will build a Lakshman Jhula-type bridge, connecting it to that bridge. People should come on foot from that side to this side and visit Vishwanath Ji, take a bath at Dashashwamedh, go to Assi Ghat, and also go to Namo Ghat, and Rajghat. I have proposed four places for arrangements to come from that side to this side. The localities of our Pakke Mahal are spiritual and cultural heritage. We have made a plan to preserve and nurture the Vedic families who study 'Batuk' (young students of Vedas) and do some work. Question: If you self-assess the tenure of the Southern Assembly, how many marks would you give out of 10? Answer: Giving marks is the public's job; I have done 100 tasks. If the public pointed out any work, it has not been left undone. Assume I have done work worth 10 out of 10 marks; if there's more, I will do it. Question: What would you say about your role in 2027? Answer: In 2027, we will break the 2017 record across the entire state, and in Kashi, assume that we always win all seats in Kashi, we will win by a larger margin, and we are working on a plan for this. If the organization gives us a chance, we will do our best. That is, in the next one-year term, we will achieve 100% of development work.

stories.title: Kanpur bride alleges abuse by in-laws:Forced nude rituals, dowry harassment; FIR filed
stories.summary: “After marriage, I discovered that my in-laws practice tantra-mantra. During the puja (worship), everyone remains naked. I was also forced to participate in the puja in a naked state. They said that they had amassed wealth through tantra. I said, ‘It is a sin to be naked in front of my mother-in-law and father-in-law. Despite this, my husband and father-in-law forcibly removed all my clothes and made me sit in the puja.” This ordeal was narrated by a 25-year-old young woman to Kanpur Police Commissioner Raghuveer Lal. On March 30, she approached him with a complaint against her in-laws. After hearing the woman's complaint, the Commissioner ordered action. Following this, an FIR was registered at the Civil Lines Women's Police Station against the accused husband, spiritual guru father-in-law, father-in-law, mother-in-law, and brother-in-law. The young woman had been married two years ago to jewelry businessman Kautuk Mishra. According to the woman, her family had spent 5 crore rupees on the wedding. A Fortuner car and gold and silver jewelry were given in dowry. The young woman has also released a video accusing her in-laws. Meanwhile, Dainik Bhaskar called to know the side of the young woman's in-laws, but the mobile was switched off. First, read what the woman said The young woman stated in her complaint letter, "My marriage took place on March 6, 2024, with Kautuk Mishra, a jewelry businessman residing in Pandu Nagar. My father spent Rs 5 crore rupees on the wedding according to his status and with the help of relatives. Additionally, a Fortuner car and gold and silver jewelry were given as dowry. Despite this, my paternal grandfather-in-law Rajendra Mishra, father-in-law Vineet, mother-in-law Rashmi, husband Kautuk, and brother-in-law Sachet were not happy with it. “After marriage, when I came to my in-laws' house, my in-laws started taunting me. They said that they had demanded 2 kg of gold and 2 crore rupees in cash, but my family did not give it. They also pressured me to bring one kg of gold, expensive furniture, and a house from my parental home,” she added. “On the day of 'Chauthi' (a post-wedding ritual), my family came; I went to my parental home with them. On the same day, I found out that my entire family, including my in-laws, practices tantra-mantra (occult rituals). I was also forced to participate in the puja (worship), which made me nervous.” 'My in-laws told me that wealth was acquired through tantric worship' The young woman said, “My in-laws worship together naked. When I was told to do so, I refused. I told them that it is a sin to be naked in front of parents-in-law. On this, the in-laws said that they had acquired so much wealth and fame through this tantric worship. After this, my husband and father-in-law forcibly undressed me.” “When I started crying, my mother-in-law hit me with slippers and said that I was possessed. My in-laws showed no mercy whatsoever. When I started running towards the room, my husband and father-in-law Vineet Mishra forcibly entered my room.” she added. “My husband locked me in the room with my father-in-law. My father-in-law applied ash on my body and said that with this, I would start obeying everything in their house, otherwise, they would drive me mad with black magic. Such brutality happened to me that I cannot express it in words.” she said. “Even when I screamed and cried, my husband did not help me. My in-laws threatened that if I cried too much or made noise, they would harm me and my family through black magic. I kept crying, and they forcibly kept me naked for hours during the puja (worship). I told my in-laws that I would go to my parents' house and tell everything. After this, my husband took me to Kolkata on the pretext of sightseeing. Then from there, he took me to Bali (Indonesia). There too, I was mistreated.” 'In-laws tried to kill me several times' The young woman said - When I became completely fed up with my in-laws' actions, after returning to my parents' house, I told my parents everything. My parents talked to my in-laws about this. The in-laws said that if I wanted to escape from this black magic, I would have to give a house in Swaroop Nagar and one kilogram of gold as dowry, only then would I be released. Otherwise, I was threatened with death through black magic. My in-laws also tried to kill me several times. Fed up with daily harassment, her parents called her back home. When her brother came to pick her up, she was sent off with only two clothes and was not allowed to take any jewelry with her. After this, she reached the Police Commissioner's office with her father and informed them about the entire incident.

stories.title: Clear skies for LSG vs DC IPL clash at Ekana:Rain ruled out; experts say, 'Fresh pitch will favour fast bowlers'
stories.summary: The 5th match of IPL 2026 will be played today at Ekana Stadium in Lucknow. The match will be between Lucknow Super Giants and Delhi Capitals. The match will start at 7:30 PM, but there was intermittent rain in the city from 12 AM to 9 AM. Due to this, cricket fans' eyes are fixed on the weather. What will be the impact of rain on the match? Will it rain again in the evening? To find this out, Dainik Bhaskar spoke to a meteorologist and a cricket expert. Mohammed Danish, a scientist at the Lucknow Meteorological Center, said that there is no rain alert for the evening. Meanwhile, Senior Sports Journalist Santosh Suri says that the pitch was covered overnight during the rain. The sun also came out during the day. If it doesn't rain in the evening, there will be no impact of rain on the pitch. However, due to the rain, there will be moisture in the pitch. This will help fast bowlers in the initial overs with the new ball bowlers getting some swing assistance. Match will be high-scoring, 4 pitches ready According to the Ekana Stadium staff, today's match will be played on a red soil pitch. The stadium has a total of 9 pitches, made of red and black soil, out of which 4 pitches are currently ready. Today's match will be on a red soil pitch. Sports journalist Santosh Suri explains, “The red soil pitch offers a little help to batsmen, so the match could be high-scoring.” See 2 pictures 46 thousand tickets sold, capacity of 50 thousand Sources associated with the match organization stated that more than 46,000 tickets for the match have been sold in online and offline modes as of this morning. Ticket prices range from 499 to 40,000 rupees. Among these, the lawn tickets are the most expensive, which also include a food package with refreshments. It should be noted that Ekana Stadium has a capacity of 50 thousand spectators. So far, 2 matches have been canceled at Ekana 22 IPL matches played at Ekana, the chasing team won 12 On the pitch of Lucknow's stadium, sometimes low-scoring and sometimes high-scoring matches are seen. Here, the dew factor also plays an important role. Due to dew, bowlers face difficulty gripping the ball in the second innings, which benefits the batting team. In such a situation, the toss will be very important. The captain winning the toss may prefer to bowl first. So far, 22 IPL matches have been played at Lucknow Stadium. Of these, the team batting first has won 9 matches, while the team chasing has won 12 matches. Also, one match has been inconclusive. Records related to IPL matches at Ekana Stadium Possible Playing-12 for both teams Delhi Capitals: KL Rahul (Wicketkeeper), Karun Nair/Pathum Nissanka, Nitish Rana, Tristan Stubbs, Axar Patel (Captain), David Miller, Ashutosh Sharma, Vipraj Nigam, Lungi Ngidi, Kuldeep Yadav, Aaqib Nabi, Thangarasu Natarajan. Lucknow Super Giants: Mitchell Marsh, Aiden Markram, Nicholas Pooran, Rishabh Pant (Wicketkeeper and Captain), Ayush Badoni, Abdul Samad, Shahbaz Ahmed, Wanindu Hasaranga, Digvesh Rathi, Mohammed Shami, Mohsin Khan, Mayank Yadav.

stories.title: Fine for wrong information in UP census:Details from radio, internet and laptop to be collected; details in 12 questions
stories.summary: The first phase of Census-2027 in Uttar Pradesh is starting today. It will be completed by September 30, 2026 (within six months). In UP, census workers will visit your home between May 22 and June 21 and collect information through 33 questions. Fifteen days before this, from May 7, people in UP can also fill in their details through an online portal. The second phase of the census will begin in February 2027. For the first time since Independence, a caste-based census is also being conducted in the country. Now, the biggest questions in people’s minds are what to do if someone is living in another city due to a job, what happens if someone does not want to be included in the census or provides incorrect information, and whether Aadhaar, PAN or property documents will be required. In today’s Bhaskar explainer, we answer 12 such questions… Question 1. What benefits will you get from the census? Answer. The census directly impacts your life, even if it is not immediately visible. It helps the government understand how many people and which sections of society live in a particular area. This ensures that schemes like ration, housing and pensions reach the right people. Accurate population data helps in planning roads, hospitals, schools and colleges. Allocation of government jobs, reservation balance and delimitation of Assembly and Lok Sabha seats also depend on census data. Question 2. What can census workers not ask us? Answer. Around 33 questions will be asked mainly about your house condition (kutcha or pucca), and availability of electricity, water, toilets, vehicles, TV and internet. However, census workers cannot ask these three things: 1) Any question related to monthly income or bank balance. 2) Pressure to show Aadhaar, PAN or any other document. 3) Private information like bank account number or OTP. Question 3. Will documents like Aadhaar, PAN card also have to be shown? Answer. No documents such as Aadhaar, PAN or citizenship papers are required to participate in the census. You also do not need to show bank details or ownership documents of your house, land or property. Question 4. What will happen if I don't participate in the census or provide incorrect information? Answer. Refusing to provide information, giving incorrect details or not cooperating with census workers is an offence. Under Section 8(2) of the Census Act, 1948, you are required to answer census-related questions. As per Section 11(1)(d) of the same law, refusing to answer or giving false information is punishable, with a fine of up to ₹1,000. Question 5. Can our personal information be misused? Answer. All information collected under the census is kept strictly confidential under Section 15 of the Census Act, 1948. Data is encrypted and stored securely on government servers. It is used only for policy-making and government schemes, leaving almost no scope for misuse. Question 6. How can I participate in the Census? Answer. You can participate in Census 2027 in two ways- 1) Canvasser Method: The census enumerator will visit your home, ask you questions, and fill them out on a digital portal. 2) Self-Enumeration (SE) Method: You can fill in all the information online through the Self-Enumeration portal. After final submission, you will receive an ID. When the census enumerator visits your home, provide that ID, and the employee will verify it. Question 7. I live on rent. Will I be excluded from the census? Answer. No, your family will not be excluded from the census. You can either fill in the information online through the SE portal or provide it to the census enumerator when they visit. For 'House Ownership', there will be two types of options: First- You live on rent but own a house elsewhere. Second- You live on rent and do not own any house. You will have to select one of these. Additionally, you will need to provide information about the portion of the rented house your family occupies. Question 8. Can I fill in my information on the portal today itself? Answer. No, the opening dates for the Self-Enumeration Portal vary by state. The Self-Enumeration Portal will remain open until exactly 15 days before the start of the House Listing and House Census phase in the state. During this period, you will be able to fill in your information. In the case of UP, this date is from May 7 to May 21, 2026. You can fill in the information on the Self-Enumeration Portal during this period. Question 9. What is the process for filling information on the Self-Enumeration Portal? Answer. Question 10. I don't know English, how do I use the portal? Answer. You don't need to worry. The portal offers options for 16 regional languages, including English and Hindi. You can use the portal by choosing a language of your convenience. Or you can wait for the census enumerator to visit your home. Question 11. What if I make a mistake while filling out online data? Answer. If any incorrect information has been entered, there is no need to worry. You can change your details before final submission of self-enumeration. If any changes are required after the form has been submitted, you can get your details corrected by the census enumerator when they visit your home. Question 12. What is necessary to do when the census enumerator visits my home? Answer. When the census enumerator visits your home, you need to do these 3 things, even if you have already filled your data through the self-enumeration portal. 1) Allow census enumerators to enter your home. 2) Allow them to write the number on your house wall or door. 3) Provide all your information accurately.

stories.title: Constable loses both legs chasing thief:Accused flees custody at Gonda station; cop run over by train while pursuing
stories.summary: A GRP constable was run over by a train while trying to catch a thief escaping from police custody at Gonda railway station in Uttar Pradesh. Both his legs were severed in the incident. The incident took place around midnight on Tuesday. Despite being critically injured, constable Akash Singh (29) managed to catch the accused Sunil Kumar (35). Hearing the commotion, GRP personnel and members of the public rushed to the spot and helped overpower the accused. Akash, a resident of Mau, was first admitted to Gonda Medical College. After primary treatment, he was referred to the trauma centre in Lucknow. His condition remains critical. Akash arrived when a fight was happening at the station According to GRP sources, a fight broke out between two youths on Platform No. 1 at around 11:30 pm on Tuesday. One of them accused Sunil Kumar of stealing money from his pocket. Constable Akash Singh, who was on duty, reached the spot and took both men outside the GRP station for questioning. After interrogation, one was let off, while Sunil Kumar was detained on suspicion. Soon after, the Dibrugarh–Chandigarh Express (15903), heading towards Lucknow, arrived at Platform No. 1. At that moment, Sunil Kumar suddenly broke free from the constable and tried to escape by boarding the moving train. Akash chased him, caught hold of him from behind while he was boarding, and pulled him down. During the scuffle with the moving train, the constable fell into the gap between the train and the platform, resulting in both his legs being severed. Caught and dragged the fleeing thief The GRP station is about 50 metres from the spot. Hearing the screams, police personnel and locals rushed in, stopped the train and pulled the constable out. The accused was also injured and later admitted to the district hospital. Doctors said - It is difficult for the constable's leg to reattach now Doctors at Gonda Medical College said that reattaching the severed leg is unlikely due to the extent of the injury. A prosthetic limb may be required, and part of the leg is missing. He was referred to Lucknow due to the severity of his condition. GRP in-charge Dinesh Kumar Pandey said the accused has been arrested and is undergoing treatment at the district hospital. CCTV footage is being examined and an investigation is underway.Akash Singh, a 2018-batch constable from Mau district, has been posted with Gonda GRP for several years. He is married and his family has reached Lucknow following the incident.

stories.title: Middle East conflict hits tourism sector:People cancel foreign trips; agents report major business loses
stories.summary: The ongoing war in the Middle East has severely impacted the tourism sector, bringing business in Gorakhpur to a standstill. A large number of people planning foreign trips during the summer vacation have cancelled their tickets. Travel agents say that all bookings for Middle Eastern countries have been cancelled. At the same time, flight tickets have become more expensive. This has also affected domestic travel, as people are now hesitant to travel even within the country due to the war. Those who are still making bookings are choosing South Asian destinations instead. Most bookings are being made for Vietnam. Apart from this, people are also opting for Singapore, Maldives and Thailand. Within India, bookings are being seen for Nainital, Shimla and Arunachal Pradesh. Shiv Mishra, owner of Hope Fun Travel Agency, said that around 30–35 bookings to Middle Eastern countries have been cancelled in the past month, involving nearly 150 passengers. More than 35 bookings cancelled Shiv Mishra said that bookings to Dubai, Saudi Arabia, Abu Dhabi, Qatar and other Middle Eastern countries have been cancelled, with about 150 passengers affected. International flight fares have also increased by 10–20 per cent, leading to a decline in bookings. For summer vacations, most travellers are now preferring Vietnam as their first choice. Vietnam emerges as top choice Bookings are also being made for Singapore, Malaysia, Mauritius, Darjeeling, Indonesia and Cambodia. Due to the ongoing war and rising flight costs, people are avoiding travel both within India and abroad. There is a fear among travellers that they might get stranded anywhere amid the crisis. March and April are usually peak seasons, but where there were earlier 150–200 bookings, the number has now dropped to just 15–20. Even earlier bookings are being cancelled. Ahmed Maaz, owner of Royal Tour and Travel India Private Limited, said that the war has impacted international tourism. Push for domestic tourism Ahmed Maaz said that while international tourism has suffered due to the war, it has increased interest among Gorakhpur residents to travel within the country. Travel agents are now promoting domestic tourism. People are choosing destinations such as Rajasthan, Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, Tamil Nadu, Varanasi, Nainital and Arunachal Pradesh. They are also offering packages to Asian countries so that people can still plan holidays. Options like Maldives, Thailand, Sri Lanka and Singapore are considered cheaper and less risky, as these routes do not pass through Middle Eastern airspace. Dhruv Gaur, owner of Tridev Tour and Travel, said that people are continuously cancelling flights. Continuous flight cancellations Dhruv Gaur said the war has heavily affected tourism. People are cancelling flights regularly, and earlier bookings are also being withdrawn. There are hardly any new bookings for foreign trips. Due to this, they have started promoting domestic tourism options. If the situation continues for long, it could create further problems, with people increasingly looking for nearby travel destinations.

stories.title: IPL match in Lucknow today:Metro services till late night, traffic diversion in place; check routes before stepping out
stories.summary: The administration in Lucknow is on alert today for the IPL 2026 match. While metro service timings have been extended, traffic diversions have also been implemented on key city routes during the match. Metro services extended till late night Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation has extended metro operations till 12:30 am for the convenience of cricket fans. The decision has been taken in view of the home match of Lucknow Super Giants, so that spectators do not face difficulty returning home after the match. Easy connectivity to Ekana Stadium To reach Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium, feeder buses are being operated every 15 minutes from Indira Nagar and Transport Nagar metro stations from 3 pm. These buses will continue to run after the match as well. Strict measures on Shaheed Path, heavy vehicles banned Traffic diversion will remain in force on Shaheed Path during the match. Entry of heavy vehicles, roadways and private buses has been completely restricted. Autos and e-rickshaws will also not be allowed on this route. Special arrangements for city buses towards the stadium Only city buses heading towards the stadium have been permitted. Buses will not be allowed to stop between Husadiya and Sushant Golf City and will operate in the right lane of the road. Stopping on service roads will be restricted, and e-rickshaws will also be banned there. Route plan for small vehicles Traffic police have prepared separate routes for autos, e-rickshaws and cabs. Vehicles coming from Arjunganj will be diverted from Ahimamau. Temporary drop-off arrangements have been made near PHQ, UP-112 and behind the maternity hospital. Vehicles coming from Sultanpur Road will drop passengers near Lulu Mall. Pick-and-drop will be completely banned within a 500-metre radius of Ahimamau. Parking plan for private vehicles Pass holders will have to park their vehicles via HCL and Water Tank Tiraha at designated parking spots. Those without passes will first park at Palassio Mall, then at alternative locations, while two-wheelers will be parked behind Palassio Mall. Entry and timing Entry will begin three hours before the match. Spectators will be allowed entry only till the middle of the second innings. Re-entry will not be permitted after exit. Police have warned of strict action for violation of rules and advised people to check the traffic plan before leaving home. Plan for heavy vehicles On April 1, traffic diversion for heavy vehicles, buses, commercial vehicles and general traffic will be in place from 3 pm in view of the IPL match at Ekana Stadium. These vehicles will follow designated alternative routes.

stories.title: Sisters-in-law clear PCS exam together in Prayagraj:Supported each other, husband says parents treated daughter-in-law as their own daughter
stories.summary: Aakriti Shukla from Prayagraj appeared for the UPPCS examination twice but could not clear the prelims on both occasions. During this time, her brother Amit got married, and Shreya Sharma became part of the family. Shreya was also preparing for UPPCS. The two became each other’s support system. Shreya helped Aakriti with her weaker subjects, while Aakriti assisted Shreya in areas she found difficult. Their in-laws treated Shreya like their own daughter and kept both Aakriti and Shreya free from household responsibilities. As a result, in the UPPCS-2024 results, Aakriti Shukla became a Deputy SP, while Shreya was selected as a Commercial Tax Officer. There is a celebratory atmosphere in the family, but many are curious about how the two supported each other to achieve success. Dainik Bhaskar spoke to their family members. Here is the story in sequence… Ancestral home in Jaunpur, family now living in Prayagraj The family lives in the Mumfordganj area of Prayagraj. Aakriti’s father, Akhilesh Shukla, originally belongs to Barji Kala village in Sujanganj, Jaunpur. He worked as a senior auditor in the Controller of Defence Accounts office and later settled in Prayagraj. The family includes his wife, son Amit, and daughter Aakriti. His two elder brothers also served in government jobs and live nearby, creating a long-standing academic environment at home. Akhilesh said that since government jobs were common in the family, a culture of studying was already present. He always supported his children in their educational choices, ensuring they pursued meaningful studies. Aakriti completed her early education at St Mary’s Convent and later did a BSc from Allahabad University. She then began preparing for competitive exams and also pursued a law degree from a state university. Attempted UPSC 2 times, did not succeed Shreya Sharma, Aakriti’s sister-in-law, is currently posted as an auditor in the PAG office in Bengaluru, Karnataka, where she lives with her husband Amit, an AI engineer. Shreya said she is originally from Ashiyana in Lucknow and studied at La Martiniere College. She completed her electrical engineering from Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University in 2019 and then decided to prepare for civil services. Her father worked in the Railways, and her brother Shubham, a software engineer, motivated her throughout. She appeared for UPSC twice but did not succeed. Later, she shifted her focus to the UPPCS exam. She cleared the prelims in 2023, raising hopes, but could not clear the mains, which left her disappointed. Sister-in-law failed prelims twice, so confidence decreased Asked how she continued preparation after marriage, Shreya said she married Amit on 20 February 2025 and continued studying even while living at her in-laws’ house in Prayagraj. She never felt like she was in a different home. She said she studied there just as she used to in Lucknow, and the best part was finding a companion in her sister-in-law Akriti. A healthy competition developed between them, and they began helping each other in writing skills as well as difficult subjects. Sister-in-law's support was like a friend, it was helpful When asked how helpful this was, Shreya said that Akriti had appeared twice for UPPCS but failed at the prelim stage both times, which had affected her confidence. The family encouraged her, with her father reminding her that success requires extra effort. With Shreya joining the household, Akriti’s confidence improved. The two began living like friends, which also helped in their studies. Amit says it is a matter of pride that both his sister and wife became officers, setting an example for those who do not treat daughters-in-law like daughters. Husband said - At home, mom and dad considered the daughter-in-law as a daughter Speaking about the family environment, Amit Shukla said there was never any pressure in the house. When Shreya came, his parents treated her like their own daughter. He said Shreya was given the same freedom as Akriti, and both managed household work as per their convenience, with their mother often helping. Their father always encouraged them to focus on studies. Amit added that at the time of their marriage, both Akriti and Shreya had appeared for the prelims and qualified for the mains. They prepared notes together and did not require any specific coaching, as they helped each other. Both cleared the mains as well, which was a first. The family was confident of their selection, though the two remained nervous, which was natural. Akriti got the third rank, Shreya got the 37th rank On the night of March 29, the UPPCS results were announced. Akriti Shukla became Deputy SP. She secured the third rank in the Deputy SP list. Shreya Sharma became a Commercial Tax Officer. She secured the 37th rank in her category. As soon as the rest of the family received the news, everyone rejoiced. Akhilesh Shukla said- Our big dream has come true. In a single day, both daughter and daughter-in-law brought glory. May every home have such daughters.

stories.title: ‘Amitabh Bachchan has one kidney, you’ll be fine’:8th pass mastermind tricks student into kidney donation; operations held in Kanpur
stories.summary: 'My father passed away 2 years ago. There is my mother and one sister at home. The responsibility of my sister's education and marriage is on me. I was not even able to pay my college fees. I saw my future going into darkness. During this time, I met Shivam Agarwal. He motivated me to donate a kidney. Shivam used to say that film actor Amitabh Bachchan has been alive for 43 years thanks to one kidney. Even at the age of 83, he is working in films. Both of Premanand Maharaj's kidneys are also damaged, nothing happened to him either I started to find Shivam, the ambulance driver's words, convincing. He used to say that if you are the sole support of your family, you can pull your family out of the clutches of poverty in exchange for one kidney. I decided to sell my kidney to give my family a good life.' This was stated by Ayush, an MBA fourth-year student from Samastipur, Bihar, who allegedly became a victim in the Kanpur kidney racket. Ayush, who donated his kidney, is currently admitted to Hallet Hospital. Before that, he was undergoing treatment at Med Life Hospital, where he narrated his ordeal to IPS officer Sumedh Jadhav. According to police, six accused, including Shivam Agarwal, have been arrested in the case. Shivam, who studied up to Class 8 and worked as an ambulance driver, is said to be the mastermind of the gang. Now read what Ayush, the kidney donor, revealed If you sell a kidney, you will get the desired price Ayush said that one of Shivam Agarwal’s associates told him that he would get any price for selling a kidney. He also showed him a chat written in a Telegram group, which mentioned that a woman with B+ blood group needed a kidney. It was the same person who introduced him to Shivam. Sell a kidney, all your sorrows and pains will go away Shivam brainwashed me. He took all information about my family and then said that if I sold one kidney, all my problems would end. I told him I would think about it. After that, Shivam kept sending me messages and making phone calls. A few days later, I met him again and refused to donate my kidney. He then asked what the problem was—whether I was scared and why I was worried. He said that Amitabh Bachchan was injured during the film ‘Coolie’, and one of his kidneys got infected, yet he is still completely fit and working in films. He also said that Premanand Maharaj’s both kidneys are damaged, yet he is fine. He told me that I am young and nothing would happen if I donated one kidney. Made an excuse to family about going to give exams Ayush said that after being convinced by Shivam, he decided to donate his kidney. After three days, when he called Shivam, he was asked to come to Ahuja Hospital. On reaching the hospital, he was told he would get ₹5 lakh. When he refused, the amount was increased and later fixed at ₹9.50 lakh. His operation was conducted on the night of March 29. He had lied to his family and come to Kanpur, telling his mother that he was going to appear for an exam and would return in three days. Now know the full story Late on the night of March 30 (Monday), police busted an illegal kidney transplant racket in Kanpur. A 23-year-old MBA student from Bihar was paid ₹6 lakh for his kidney, which was later sold to a 30-year-old woman patient for around ₹80 lakh. After the student complained to the police, raids were conducted the same night at Med Life Hospital, Ahuja Hospital and Priya Hospital. At Med Life Hospital, both the kidney donor Ayush and the patient were found admitted. When documents related to the transplant were sought, the hospital failed to produce any valid papers. On March 31 (Tuesday), police arrested Ahuja Hospital owner Dr Preeti Ahuja, her husband Dr Surjeet, Dr Rajesh Kumar, Dr Ram Prakash, Dr Narendra Singh and agent Shivam Agarwal and sent them to jail. Now know what is the connection between the 6 accused? How did the syndicate work? Gathered information of dialysis patients, shared on Telegram Police Commissioner Raghubir Lal said the syndicate worked in an organised manner. Dr Afzal collected details of long-term dialysis patients through hospital contacts and approached them for transplants. Patient details were then shared in Telegram groups, which included doctors and agents. Parul Tomar, wife of a school operator from Muzaffarnagar, was contacted by Dr Afzal. Parul had been undergoing dialysis for 8 years Parul had been on dialysis for the past eight years and agreed to the transplant after contact with Dr Afzal. Initial investigation revealed that the deal was fixed at ₹80 lakh. Her details were shared on Telegram, stating that a 30-year-old woman with B+ blood group needed a kidney and the donor would get a high price. This is how Ayush came in contact with Shivam. After the operation at Ahuja Hospital on Sunday, Parul was admitted to Priya Hospital. She is now being treated at Hallet Hospital. Shivam himself used to find and bring donors Police Commissioner Raghubir Lal said that after the deal was finalised, Shivam contacted Dr Rohit, who brought a team of 7–8 doctors from Delhi and Lucknow, including specialists in anaesthesia, surgery and medicine. After the operation, donor and recipient were shifted to separate hospitals, where they were kept under observation for 4–5 days before discharge. In case of complications, patients were referred to higher centres in Lucknow and Delhi. The entire setup was prepared in a cinematic style During police interrogation, Shivam said 7–8 operations had been conducted at Ahuja Hospital and similar illegal transplants were carried out in around seven hospitals in Kanpur and Lucknow. All operations were conducted at night, and both donor and recipient were admitted three days in advance. CCTVs used to be turned off Dr Rohit fixed the date and time of operations, which were conducted only at night. If families hesitated, they were told the doctor was unavailable during the day. Before the team arrived, CCTV cameras were switched off. Hospital staff were sent on leave on the day of surgery, and only Dr Rohit’s team remained inside. All medicines and arrangements were handled by the team. After surgery, donor and recipient were shifted early morning to different hospitals without documentation. Shivam transported them in his ambulance. 7 hospitals in Kanpur-Lucknow on police radar On the evening of March 31, Med Life Hospital was sealed, while Ahuja Hospital was issued a notice and will also be sealed. Priya Hospital has also been served a notice seeking a reply. Police Commissioner Raghubir Lal said that initial investigation has revealed that more than 50 illegal kidney transplants have been conducted in Kanpur so far. Dr Rohit has also performed operations at other locations in Kanpur and is in contact with doctors in Delhi. In connection with the kidney transplant case, seven hospitals—one in Lucknow and six in Kanpur—are under the scanner.

stories.title: 14,000 PNG consumers surrender LPG connections:Surge in applications for pipeline connections; transfer requests rise by 100%
stories.summary: In Agra, as the number of PNG consumers rises, the trend of surrendering LPG connections has also begun. So far, 14,000 PNG users have surrendered their LPG connections. This step has been taken following instructions from the Petroleum Ministry and due to a shortage of domestic cylinders. Green Gas Company had sent a list of 75,000 PNG consumers to oil companies. Out of these, 14,000 consumers have surrendered their LPG connections so far. The highest number—around 8,000—belongs to Indian Oil Corporation (IOC). Trend of LPG connection surrender begins Applications for LPG connection transfers have increased by 100 percent. Under existing rules, domestic cylinders can be booked every 25 days in urban areas and every 45 days in rural areas. In view of this, LPG consumers have found a middle path. Gas agencies are also facing pressure to issue new connections. The district has 84 gas agencies with 1.357 million consumers, including 700,000 under IOC. Earlier, around 10 to 15 applications were received per week, but now the number has doubled. A gas agency operator said most consumers are applying for agencies closer to their homes, which could further increase difficulties. Consumers have already booked cylinders before applying, meaning they will not receive another cylinder for the next 45 days. Applications for LPG connection transfers have increased by 100 percent. stories.title: 'Hundreds of Hindus were killed in Sambhal 50 years ago':CM Yogi in Mathura says now parikrama is happening, Ram is king of Sanatan
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Tuesday said that Lord Ram is the eternal king of India and no one else. He also claimed that a temple in Sambhal was demolished in 1526 during Babur’s time and spoke about past riots in which many Hindus were killed. He said that earlier governments withdrew cases related to those incidents, but now development work has started at the site. According to him, a road and a dharamshala are being built there, and the parikrama will also begin soon. Yogi made these remarks while addressing a programme in Vrindavan, Mathura, on the 452nd birth anniversary of Saint Malukdas. During the event, he also honoured saints present on the stage by offering them shawls. The Chief Minister reached Vrindavan at around 4:15 pm, where his helicopter landed at the Pawan Hans helipad. After getting information about his arrival, district officials, including the DM and SP, rushed to the spot. Earlier in the day, heavy rain and strong winds hit Mathura. Due to the storm, tents set up for the programme were blown away, but officials later repaired them in time. RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat had also attended the birth anniversary programme earlier in the afternoon. See 4 pictures Now read 5 big statements made by CM Yogi... Saint Ramanandacharya made great men from many castes saints Yogi said- Saint Ramanandacharya made great men associated with different castes saints. Saint Raidas and Saint Kabir were also his disciples. In the 22nd generation of the same tradition, Jagadguru Malukdas Ji Maharaj is remembered. This is our tradition, which has thought about India. Not just for its own sect or community, but has thought for Sanatan and the nation. When saints come on one platform and speak in one voice, then the 500-year-old blemish of Ayodhya is erased and removed. This is the power of unity. India's Eternal King is Ram India's eternal king is Ram and no one else. Those who say that Tulsidas was a poor Brahmin, who could be greater than him? He had rejected the proposal of the greatest emperor of that time. He had said that he did not know any emperor. He only knew one emperor, who is the greatest in the world - that is Ram. There is no caste discrimination in Ramlila From October to December, Ramlila takes place in every village of North India from late evening to late night. The government does not support Ramlila; the villagers themselves collect donations. The people from the village become the characters. There is no discrimination based on caste or creed there. Everyone watches and listens to it unitedly. This tradition was started by Saint Tulsidas in the medieval period. Advancing heritage along with development Development is only meaningful when heritage is also preserved. That is why both tasks are progressing simultaneously. You must have seen in Kashi how grand and divine the Kashi Vishwanath Dham has become. Earlier, when a follower of Sanatan Dharma came to Kashi, they faced many difficulties. In 1916, when Mahatma Gandhi arrived in Kashi and saw the narrow lanes and dirt, he had said that if any creature fell here, what would it say? In 2017, when I had the opportunity to visit Kashi, even 50 people could not go together at that time. But today, 50,000 people can visit simultaneously. This is the effort of the double-engine government. This is the pace of development that we are taking towards progress. In Sambhal, Harihar Temple was demolished by Babar's followers No one can be greater than Sanatan Dharma. In Ayodhya, we witnessed the liberation of Ram Janmabhoomi. We became witnesses to the grand consecration ceremony. The year is 2026. In the year 1526, the Harihar temple in Sambhal was demolished by Babar's followers. There were 67 pilgrimage sites and 19 wells there. Riots occurred in 1976 and 1978, in which hundreds of Hindus were killed. Later, during the SP government, the cases were withdrawn. Now a road is being built there and a parikrama (circumambulation) is also starting. In 1528, Babar's commander demolished the Ram temple. We took it back before 500 years were complete. Before 2017, Ayodhya had electricity for 3 hours Even in Ayodhya, before 2017, electricity was available for only 3 hours. There were narrow lanes and a constant fear of accidents. If you visit Ayodhya today, its appearance reminds one of the Treta Yuga. This is the result of the penance and struggle of the saints. If there is so much power in the unity of saints, then the entire Sanatan society, united, will not allow any anti-religious or anti-Hindu conspiracy to succeed. This journey must not be stopped; it must be continuously moved forward. -

stories.title: Blue drum murder accused Muskaan-Sahil to get sentence soon:Saurabh’s friend gives final testimony in Meerut court, makes big revelation
stories.summary: In the Saurabh murder case of Meerut, the last witness gave his statement in court on Tuesday. The witness, Sanjeev Pal, is Saurabh’s childhood friend and the last person who tried to contact him on the phone. Sanjeev told the court that he called Saurabh many times. After several attempts, Muskan answered the call. He said that as soon as she picked up the phone, she started scolding and abusing him. She told him that they had gone to Manali for an outing and asked why he was calling again and again. With this, statements of all 22 witnesses in the case have now been completed. The court will now hear the final arguments. The verdict in the case is likely to come by the end of April. Muskan had abused and cut the call Sanjeev said, Saurabh was my childhood friend. Saurabh and I studied together in the same school. Saurabh was missing. While Muskan and Sahil had gone to visit Uttarakhand and Himachal. At that time, everyone wanted to talk to Saurabh. But no one was able to talk to Saurabh. Then on March 8, I called Saurabh on his mobile. I called 3-4 times, but the call was not answered. After a long time, Muskan received the call and started scolding me. She told me - Can't you see that we have come to Manali for a trip? You are bothering us by calling repeatedly. Then I replied, Bhabhi, please let me talk to Saurabh once. Then Muskan abused me and hung up the phone. She threatened me not to call this number after today. Muskan had said that Saurabh and I have come to Kasol for a trip, don't bother us by calling. I cannot let you talk to Saurabh right now. Read what the court asked Sanjeev Question- How was Saurabh's behavior towards his wife Muskan? Answer- He was a very caring husband. Since he had a love marriage with Muskan against his family's wishes, he loved Muskan even more. He fulfilled her every wish. He kept her happy. Question- What is your relationship with Saurabh? Answer- He was my childhood friend. We studied in the same school from the beginning. Question- What did you talk about with Saurabh's wife Muskan? Answer- I told Muskan on a call to let me talk to Saurabh once. So she said, "Don't disturb us. Saurabh is with me. We have come out to travel, you are bothering us. Don't call this number again." Question- On what date did you talk to Muskan? Answer- I spoke to Muskan on March 8th. Question- How long have you known Saurabh? Answer- Saurabh has been my friend since childhood. Muskan and Saurabh to appear in court Senior Advocate Vijay Bahadur Singh, who is fighting the case on behalf of Saurabh, said- Sanjeev Pal's testimony has been recorded. He had studied with Saurabh till 10th grade. Now all the witnesses in the case have been finalized. The case file has been presented under Section 313 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC). A date has been set for the defense after Section 313. After this, the final arguments will take place. Thereafter, the verdict in the case will be pronounced. During the arguments under Section 313, both Muskan and Sahil will be summoned to appear in court. Both will have to appear physically in court. Until now, testimonies were being taken by connecting both of them via video conferencing from jail. Actually, Section 313 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC) (now under BNSS) is the court's power to question the accused in criminal cases. It gives the court an opportunity to directly question the accused based on witness statements and evidence, so that they can clarify the evidence against them or present their defense. Now understand the Saurabh murder case completely 2016: Saurabh met Muskan for the first time, rebelled against his family Saurabh Rajput's job was in the Merchant Navy. His posting was in London. He used to travel back and forth to India. He mostly stayed abroad on ships. In 2016, Saurabh came to Meerut. It was here that he met Muskan Rastogi for the first time. Muskan was smitten by Saurabh's profile. Both started meeting secretly from their families. When the matter reached marriage, the family's opposition came to light. Saurabh's father Munnalal, brother Rahul, and mother Renu were not ready. However, going against his family, Saurabh Kumar had a love marriage with Muskan. Due to this, there was an ongoing dispute with his family. The family disinherited him from the property. Saurabh started living on rent with Muskan in Ompal's house in Indiranagar. Where his wife Muskan Rastogi and 8-year-old daughter Pihu also lived. 2019: Fell in love with Sahil, planned to get married According to Muskan's story, the twist in this love story came in 2019. At that time, Pihu was in play school. Muskan used to drop her daughter off at school because Saurabh was mostly out. Muskan met Sahil Shukla for the first time outside the school. Muskan used to live alone at home. Sahil took advantage of this. They started meeting outside the house. They also had physical relations. According to Muskan, everything was going well until 2022. Saurabh used to stay in Meerut for only 2 to 3 months a year. The rest of the time Muskan spent with Sahil. But now Sahil started pressuring her to get married and live together. "Divorce Saurabh," he demanded. Muskan stabbed Saurabh after he fell asleep Muskan's birthday was on February 25, 2025. Exactly one day before, on February 24, Saurabh had come to Meerut to celebrate her birthday. After Saurabh returned, Sahil became restless. It was decided that Saurabh had to be removed from the way on March 4. Muskan first put Pihu to sleep in the room next to the bedroom. That night, she mixed sedatives in the dinner. Saurabh fell asleep quickly after eating. After this, Muskan called Sahil. After Sahil arrived, Muskan stabbed Saurabh in the chest. After Saurabh's death, his body was dragged into the bathroom. Muskan and Sahil together cut the body into 4 pieces. To hide them, they brought a large plastic drum for filling water from the market. The body pieces were filled in this drum. Both stayed in the lobby all night with the dead body Muskan and Sahil knew that the dead body would smell after decomposing. So, they poured water over the dead body and filled it with cement. After this, both stayed together in the same lobby all night. On the morning of March 5, 2025, Muskan woke Pihu up. She took Pihu to her mother Kavita's house and left her there. Then she came back and went to visit Shimla-Manali with Sahil. Muskan had taken Saurabh's mobile with her. From there, she kept operating Saurabh's WhatsApp. Sahil told the police that they both got married in a temple in Shimla. But their money was running out on hotels, food, and sightseeing. Saurabh had 6 lakh rupees in his bank account. Muskan was unable to withdraw that money. At the behest of her mother Kavita, Muskan returned to Meerut with Sahil on March 17. After this, the whole matter started to unravel. Muskan gave birth to a daughter last November Currently, Muskan and Sahil are lodged in Meerut District Jail. A police charge sheet has been filed against them. When Muskan was arrested on March 19, 2025, she was one and a half months pregnant. She gave birth to a daughter on November 24, 2025. Sahil is working in gardening in jail.

stories.title: Woman jumps from 16th floor in Ghaziabad:Preparing for UP Police, family alleges someone pushed her
stories.summary: In Ghaziabad, on Tuesday morning, around 6:10 AM, a young woman committed suicide by jumping from the 16th floor. At the time of the incident, the young woman was in a semi-naked state. As soon as she fell, there was a commotion in the society, and people from the vicinity gathered at the spot. The young woman, Sandhya (18), was preparing for UP Police recruitment. Her father works as a clothes presser in the same society, due to which she used to frequent the place. Her family members alleged that someone pushed Sandhya from the 16th floor. Upon receiving the information, the police reached the spot, took the body into custody, and sent it for post-mortem. Police are scrutinizing the CCTV camera footage installed in the society. The incident occurred at Jaipuria Sunrise Green Society, located in the Indirapuram police station area. She went out for a run from home, her body was found in the society Sandhya was the daughter of Sukhdev Kanojia, a resident of Hardoi district. Sukhdev has been living with his family in Kanawani village, Ghaziabad, for the past 30 years. He works as an ironer of clothes in Jaipuria Sunrise Green Society. He has three daughters. Sandhya used to go for a run every morning. On Tuesday morning too, she left home for a run. During this, she reached the society and jumped from the C block of the 16th floor of the building in a semi-naked state. At that time, she was not wearing full clothes. According to the police, the girl is seen going alone in the lift in the society's CCTV footage. She was also seen exiting the lift alone from the lift on the 16th floor. An investigation into the matter has been started. However, the reason for the incident is not yet clear. Father said - My daughter cannot jump The deceased's father, Sukhdev Kanojia, said - I cannot believe that my daughter committed suicide. I suspect a conspiracy in this whole matter. Someone must have called her up with the lift and then deliberately pushed her. He has demanded an impartial investigation from the police. ACP Indirapuram Abhishek Srivastava said - Around 6:30 AM, police received information that the body of a young woman was found near C Tower of Jaipuriya Sunrise Green Society. Upon receiving the information, police reached the spot, took the body into custody, and sent it for post-mortem. Further action is being taken based on the complaint filed by the family members. Footage from nearby CCTV cameras is also being scrutinized.

stories.title: Storm in Mathura blows away tent for CM's event:Gate collapses on auto in Agra, trees and poles uprooted in Hathras
stories.summary: The spell of rain and strong winds has not stopped in Uttar Pradesh despite the heat. In Mathura, strong winds and rain hit on Tuesday afternoon, blowing away the tent set up for the Sant Malook Das birth anniversary programme. The administration quickly restored the arrangements. RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat had attended the event earlier in the morning. Heavy rain also began around 3 pm in Ghaziabad and Noida. In Badaun, strong winds were followed by heavy rainfall in the afternoon. Earlier in the day, light showers were seen at intervals in Lucknow and Meerut. The weather department has issued an alert for thunderstorms, rain and hail in 34 districts today. In some areas, winds may reach speeds of up to 60 kmph. The weather is expected to remain unsettled for the next two days, until 9 April. Due to rain and strong winds, the average temperature across the state has dropped by 4 to 5°C. In the past four days, rain has been recorded in 43 districts including Varanasi and Kanpur. Hailstorms were reported in 10 cities, including Mathura, Sambhal and Jalaun. So far, 15 people have died due to storms and lightning. Lucknow's meteorologist Atul Singh said- A new Western Disturbance is becoming active from today. There will be rain with storms across the entire state. Hail will also fall. Wind speed will reach up to 60 km. Temperature will drop by 3 to 5 degrees. Its maximum impact will be seen in Western UP tomorrow, i.e., April 8th. The weather will remain like this until April 9th. How will the weather be for the next 2 days? See today's weather pictures - How many deaths in which districts due to storm-rain, know In the last 4 days, 4 people died in Kanpur due to storm-rain and lightning. Additionally, 3 people died in Sitapur, and 2 each in Varanasi, Chitrakoot, Siddharthnagar, and Lalitpur. Damage to wheat-mustard crops due to unseasonal rain Yogi said - negligence will not be tolerated, officers should remain alert CM Yogi has said that any kind of negligence in the damage being caused to farmers due to rain will not be tolerated. He has sought damage reports from all DMs. He said - all officials should remain on alert mode. Ensure that the impact of the disaster on farmers is minimized. If there is any loss of life, property, or livestock, or if anyone is injured, compensation should be provided within 24 hours.

stories.title: MLA’s son occupies superintendent’s seat:Visits government hospital in Rampur; reprimands doctors during inspection
stories.summary: A 22-year-old man, Umair Ansari, son of an Apna Dal (S) MLA, inspected a government hospital in Rampur and questioned doctors and staff. He visited the Community Health Centre (CHC) in Swar on Saturday morning around 11 AM. During the visit, he entered the emergency ward, spoke to patients and asked doctors about treatment. He later went to the Superintendent’s office, sat on the official chair, checked documents and scolded doctors. Four policemen, including a sub-inspector and three constables, were seen providing him security without any official protocol. The hospital staff and the superintendent appeared helpless during the visit, as the MLA’s son continued to show authority for nearly an hour. The video of the incident surfaced on Monday. Chief Medical Officer Deepa Singh has ordered an inquiry and asked for a report within 7 days. The Superintendent of Police has also ordered an inquiry into the policemen. Shafiq Ahmed Ansari is the MLA from Suar seat. Umair Ansari's mother, Reshma Parveen, is the Chairperson of Suar Nagar Palika. When MLA father Shafiq Ansari was asked about his son's CHC inspection, he said- I was out of the area. I received complaints about mismanagement at the CHC. That's why I personally sent my son to check the arrangements. His going for inspection is not wrong in any way. See pictures related to the MLA's son's inspection The MLA's son was seen sitting on the Superintendent's chair in CHC. Nearby, the Superintendent stood showing documents. Now, the complete matter in sequence MLA's son Umair reached Swar CHC for inspection at 11 AM on Saturday. Along with Umair, there were 4 policemen and two supporters. It is visible in the video that he first reached the emergency ward and inquired about the patients' condition. He checked the employees' attendance registers. He observed the medicine distribution system. He also checked the functioning of the lab and the condition of the machines. After this, Umair reached the CHC Superintendent's office. As soon as he saw the MLA's son, CHC In-charge Dr. Rajiv Chandel left his chair and stood up. Umair sat on his chair. He started checking documents there. During this, Dr. Rajiv stood beside him and was seen showing him documents. Umair questioned the CHC In-charge and doctors. He warned the CHC Superintendent that patients should not be prescribed outside medicines. They should not be sent outside for tests. If this is found to be the case, action will be taken. CMO said - MLA's son has no right to investigate CMO Dr. Deepa Singh said - The MLA's son or any family member has no right to inspect a government institution. Sitting on an officer's chair and giving instructions is a violation of protocol. A team has been constituted under the chairmanship of ACMO Santosh Kumar to investigate the matter. It is being investigated which protocols have been violated. The team has been asked to submit the report within 7 days. Action will be taken based on the report. SP Somendra Meena said- An investigation will be conducted into what order or protocol policemen were present with the MLA's son. If a violation of rules is found, action will be taken.Umair reprimanded the doctors and staff. Warned of action.storage.

stories.title: Chirag Paswan to contest polls independently in UP:LJP (R) to contest on all 403 seats, party says 'Alliance with BJP is only at Centre'
stories.summary: Chirag Paswan’s party, Lok Janshakti Party (Ramvilas), which has established a strong foothold in Bihar politics, is now set to enter the electoral arena of Uttar Pradesh. The party has announced that it will contest all 403 seats in the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. This move is being seen as an effort to strengthen its base among Dalit and youth voters in the state. It has also triggered political debate over which parties may face pressure following Chirag’s entry into UP politics. No state alliance despite NDA ties Rajeev Paswan, the party’s East UP State President, clarified that while the party is aligned with the BJP at the Centre, there is no alliance in Uttar Pradesh. He said the party will contest the elections independently with the slogans ‘UP First’ and ‘People of UP first’. At present, Chirag Paswan is a Union Minister in the National Democratic Alliance government led by Narendra Modi. However, his focus in Uttar Pradesh is expected to be on the Dalit vote bank. A significant portion of this vote base is traditionally held by the Bahujan Samaj Party, while Chandrashekhar Azad of the Azad Samaj Party is also actively working to consolidate it. Expansion after Bihar success Following a 100% strike rate in the Lok Sabha elections and a strong performance in the Bihar Assembly elections, Chirag Paswan is now looking to expand the party’s footprint nationally. Party sources suggest that he believes his father, Ram Vilas Paswan, had a considerable support base in Uttar Pradesh. The current strategy aims to revive that base and position the party as a third political alternative in the state. Split within the party after Ram Vilas Paswan’s death After the death of Ram Vilas Paswan, the party witnessed a major split on 14 June 2021. Five MPs—Pashupati Kumar Paras, Choudhary Mehboob Ali Kaiser, Veena Devi, Chandan Singh, and Prince Raj, removed Chirag Paswan from all party posts. Pashupati Kumar Paras, Chirag’s uncle, was chosen as their leader. This development came months after the 2020 Bihar Assembly elections and the passing of Ram Vilas Paswan. Setback: Loss of power and position On 7 July 2021, Pashupati Paras became a Union Minister, further sidelining Chirag from power at both the Centre and the state level. Chirag also had to vacate the government bungalow allotted in his father’s name. At that stage, his political career appeared to be at a standstill. Analysts observed that the internal family conflict had significantly weakened his position, with his uncle seemingly taking control of Ram Vilas Paswan’s political legacy. Political struggle and rebuilding phase Despite these setbacks, Chirag Paswan did not withdraw from politics. He continued his political struggle, including a phase of rebellion against Nitish Kumar in Bihar. Observers note that Chirag remained politically active and positioned himself as a loyal supporter of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, often describing himself as his ‘Hanuman’. His persistence paid off when he secured victory from the Hajipur seat, reaffirming his political relevance. Resurgence in the 2024 Lok Sabha Elections Ahead of the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, the rivalry between Chirag and his uncle resurfaced, particularly over the Hajipur seat. Pashupati Paras was reluctant to уступ the constituency, leading to prolonged negotiations within the NDA. Senior BJP leaders, including JP Nadda, were involved in discussions, but the deadlock persisted for some time. Eventually, Chirag strengthened his position within the alliance and secured his political ground. This phase marked a turning point, with Chirag emerging as a key player within the NDA. Strong showing in Bihar Assembly Polls In the 2025 Bihar Assembly elections, Lok Janshakti Party (Ramvilas) delivered an impressive performance as part of the NDA alliance. The party contested around 28–29 seats and won 19 of them, signalling a significant political comeback. Delighted by this success, Chirag Paswan is now aiming to replicate his gains in Uttar Pradesh and establish his party as a formidable force beyond Bihar.

stories.title: Speeding car collides with Budh Vihar Gate in Gorakhpur:Bullet also hit, vehicle loses rear wheel, it flies and falls 50 metres away
stories.summary: In the Ramgarh Taal police station area of Gorakhpur, a speeding car met with an accident on Monday night. This incident occurred around 10 PM at the main gate of Buddha Vihar located in Paddleganj. According to eyewitnesses, a Volkswagen Polo car coming from the direction of Nauka Vihar was at high speed. After suddenly losing control, the car crashed straight into the gate of Buddha Vihar. The impact was so severe that the rear wheels of the car detached and flew approximately 50 meters away. During the accident, a Bullet bike that was moving in front of the car also came under its impact. The people riding on the bike were seriously injured. After the incident, chaos ensued at the spot and people from nearby gathered. Some people helped the injured, while some were seen making videos and taking photos. After the accident, the people in the car abandoned the vehicle and fled from the spot. Upon receiving information, Padaleganj outpost police reached the spot and immediately sent the injured to the district hospital. According to police, the condition of all the injured is being reported as stable at present. Police have taken the car into custody and started investigating the case, and a search is underway for the absconding accused. Police say that the accused will be caught soon and the actual causes of the incident are being investigated.

stories.summary: Students are protesting outside the Vice-Chancellor’s residence at Kashi Hindu University. The issue relates to Bhagwan Das Hostel. It is reported that an expelled student had come to the hostel for a meal. During this time, the warden arrived and locked Room No. 90 of the student who was staying with him. Students have alleged that when the other student had done nothing wrong, why was he evicted and his room locked? Dispute over room locking A student stated that a student named Shani had been expelled from his room after being found guilty in a dispute. However, as two students share one room, the warden also removed the other boy living there and locked the room. When he tried to call, there was no response. Following this, students gathered outside the Vice-Chancellor’s residence, whom they consider their guardian. Meanwhile, members of the Proctorial Board arrived with their faces covered. Demand for action against warden Agitated students have staged a protest outside the VC’s residence, demanding action against the warden. In view of the protest, a large police presence along with the Proctorial Board team has been deployed. Authorities are currently attempting to calm the situation through dialogue with the students.
