stories.title: 'Akhilesh hasn’t visited Kannauj as MP':Social Welfare Minister Asim Arun says officials kept him waiting 45 minutes
stories.summary: State Minister for Social Welfare (Independent Charge) Aseem Arun is in the news after he left a government programme in Kannauj. He walked out because the District Magistrate and Superintendent of Police did not arrive on time. The minister said this was not a personal issue. He claimed he had to wait for 45 minutes, and around 100–200 people were also waiting at the venue. He added that such delays happen regularly. Speaking on local politics, Arun targeted Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav, who is the Member of Parliament from Kannauj. He said that as an MP, Yadav only focuses on building cemetery boundary walls, visits the area once in two months, and often returns from the expressway without meeting people. When asked about his experience as a police officer during the Samajwadi Party government, Arun made serious allegations. He said the party wanted to shut down the Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS) and had filed applications to withdraw cases against terrorists. He added that at that time, the judiciary had taken a firm stand, and people are aware of the party’s position on such issues. Read the full interview of BJP MLA Aseem Arun Question. Akhilesh Yadav is the MP from Kannauj, what kind of coordination do you have with him? Aseem. There is no coordination with Akhileshji at all. I congratulated him on his election and said we should work together for the development of Kannauj, but I never saw anything like that from his side. In fact, I was also seeing reports in the newspaper that he has only given MP funds for building walls of some graveyards. As an MP, he has not done any work in two and a half years. Kannauj also probably comes once every 2 months. They meet people on the expressway and go back. This is how they behave. But, that is their subject. They do their politics in a different way. We do ground-level politics. Question. You were the ATS chief in the SP government. Was there ever any pressure? Aseem. The SP government had made up its mind to shut down the ATS. You must have seen how they decided to withdraw all the cases against terrorists and also filed an application. I would like to thank our judiciary, who took a stand. We all know what the SP's stance was against terrorists. Question. The opposition alleges that officers do not listen to the public and public representatives? Do you agree with this? Aseem. It's not like that, basically, democracy and bureaucracy, both are important aspects of the government. The constitution decided that there would be MPs and MLAs. The direction to be given is to be given by the elected representatives. Now, the bureaucracy, the police department, is doing its job well. Yes, the Yogi government has increased accountability. After investigation of complaints, action is also taken. Question. In Kannauj, the DM made you wait for a long time, you expressed displeasure, and also wrote a letter. Aseem. I was invited to that program. The program didn't even start for 45 minutes. The officers didn't show up, I objected. Those officers apologized. I also forgave them, and the matter ended there. It's not my personal issue that I had to wait for 45 minutes. 100-200 people had to wait there. This happens every day. It's also important to use this incident as a positive aspect, which is why I have started a campaign that we will come to the office on time. We will also give time to family. Question. You inspected the Kannauj Collectorate, many officers were absent, why is it not making any difference? Aseem. In my department, we implemented facial recognition attendance. Now, inspections are less frequent because I can see it on the app itself. According to the rules we made, if someone is 15 minutes late, they are given a warning. If they are late again, their leave is deducted. Question. For a long time, UP has not had a permanent DGP, how do you view this tradition? Aseem. There is a DGP in UP, the Supreme Court had issued an order. Based on that, a process was determined by UPSC. I understand that process is discriminatory. Understand that under it, a panel of three people will be formed. If you study for 10 years, only those people will be selected who joined service at the age of 21-22. Those who join service at 25-26 years can never become DGP. Secondly, those who have come through reservation, who are Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe, will never be able to become DGP for 10 years, because they will not even come in the top three in empanelment. This is my personal opinion and I think the Supreme Court should reconsider this. I think the state government should have the full right to choose important posts like Chief Secretary, DGP. Question. You became an MLA from Kannauj 4 years ago, how much of the promises you made to the public have you been able to fulfill? Aseem. Kannauj's lifeline GT Road and all PWD roads have been strengthened. Understand that work was done at 30% less cost. Meaning, 1 crore was sanctioned, but construction was completed in 70 lakhs. Because continuous inspections were carried out against corruption. Local people supported a lot. The major responsibility of the Social Welfare Department is to provide pensions to the elderly, a campaign was launched across UP. Only 400 children from Kannauj are studying in Sarvodaya Vidyalaya. Question. Is there any work as an MLA that you feel should have been done much earlier? Aseem. I believe there are 3 good ponds in Kannauj. Due to neglect in the previous government, they remained dirty. Under the Amrit-2 scheme, all three ponds were excavated with 1 crore rupees. Now they have fresh water. There are fish in them, where there was dirt, now there is beauty. Question. Is there any work that you haven't been able to get done yet? Aseem. Well, there would be a very long list. We asked our colleagues in the assembly - where should the MLA fund be spent? Everyone said - it should only be spent on health and education. The result was that there are 40 schools where we gave 20-20 lakh rupees. We upgraded the PHC (Primary Health Center). Modernized 3 main wards of the district hospital. Further, we are trying to make the emergency of Kannauj District Hospital the best. Its proposal is being prepared by the CMS. A fund of 1.5 crore has been pledged. We want that only in extreme circumstances should anyone be referred from Kannauj to Delhi, Lucknow, Kanpur. Question. You left khaki for khadi, it's been 4 years. How has the experience been? Aseem. The way police work in uniform is different; orders are given there, but in politics, there are requests, because here everyone is an equal worker. As for the Social Welfare Department, orders are followed there, but unlike the police department, commands are not strictly enforced, this is what I understood. I have found some sharp officers, and the results are also good. Question. 28 years versus 4 years, which is better? Aseem. Both are very good. Was everything sweet in the police job...no. Sometimes I also encountered bitterness. Sometimes I faced stones, many times I had to face bullets. Now in politics, will everything always be sweet here? Both are acceptable. Question. You were the Police Commissioner in Kanpur. The election was announced. You suddenly resigned and joined BJP. How did the idea suddenly come to you? Aseem. BJP is a very strong party. The dynastic politics of other parties does not allow new leaders to emerge. New leaders are created in BJP. This policy is taking BJP forward. I am not alone, 12 doctors are also MLAs in BJP, there are PhD holders, lawyers, businessmen and media people. BJP works to develop diversity and expertise. I am also a part of it. Question. Did BJP choose you or did you choose BJP? Aseem. I am very grateful to the BJP, because providing opportunities is the BJP's policy. I understand that other parties focus on dynastic politics. They are busy promoting their children, whereas in BJP, leaders also emerge from the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad. The BJP understands how to win elections and people's hearts. Question. You talked about dynastic politics. Kalyan Singh's third generation is in politics, Rajnath Singh's son is an MLA. Is this not dynastic politics? Aseem. By dynastic politics, I mean that if someone's son or daughter is not capable, but they are being promoted, that is wrong. But if someone is capable, but is not being chosen just because they are a leader's son or daughter. There is a need to understand this balance. In BJP, our colleagues whose parents, grandparents, maternal grandparents have been in politics, they are working hard. For them, getting a ticket and contesting elections is as difficult as it is for a first-generation politician like me. Question. Did you ever feel that the decision to leave the police uniform was wrong? Aseem. Not at all, wearing the police uniform has its joy, but now I am in politics, fortunately the people of Kannauj have blessed me. Question. Do you consider the participation of Dalits in the BJP organization and government to be sufficient? Aseem. In BJP, we take everyone along. We also work for those who do not vote for us. Let's assume that next time we will get their votes too. I have been elected as the MLA of Kannauj, so even those who did not vote for me are my responsibility. BJP works to unite everyone. Question. Mayawati is also called the messiah of Dalits. She is getting weaker day by day. What do you consider to be the reason behind this? Aseem. If we start from 1989, the next 30 years were a time of social justice politics. Backward politics progressed, and it also had some good results. But our politics is maturing. Modiji has pulled the country out of vote bank politics. In a democracy, if I consider 20,000 votes of a particular community as my own, I will stop working. If there is doubt, I will run around and work for them. Kanshiramji did a great job in BSP. However, there is a need to move out of vote bank politics, because even then parties will come to your doorstep. Question. A CO in Sambhal says that whoever supports Iran should go to Iran, how do you view this in the police? Aseem. This statement is not in my knowledge. But when we wear the police uniform, we detach ourselves from the feelings of religion, caste, region, and language.

stories.title: Allahabad High Court reshuffles 711 judicial officers:Maximum transfers across key UP districts, including 266 ADJs; see full list
stories.summary: The Allahabad High Court on Sunday ordered the transfer of 266 Additional District and Sessions Judges. Registrar General Manjeet Singh Shyoran released the list, directing all officers to hand over charge by April 15 and take charge at their new postings. Several judge couples have been posted together. Santosh Kumar Yadav and Sandeepa Yadav have been moved from Azamgarh to Bareilly, while Vikas Nagar and Pratiksha Nagar have been transferred from Gautam Buddh Nagar to Gorakhpur. Gopal Ji and Machala Agrawal have been shifted from Bulandshahr to Sambhal, and Gaurav Sharma with Neetu Pathak from Ghaziabad to Varanasi. In another set of transfers, Nishant Yadav and Archana Yadav have been moved from Lucknow to Shahjahanpur, while Jyotna Sivach and Anurag Panwar have been transferred from Lucknow to Muzaffarnagar. Sita Ram and Alka Bharti have been posted from Muzaffarnagar to Rampur, and Manoj Kumar Sidhu with Garima Singh have also been shifted to Muzaffarnagar. Abhay Pratap Singh and Anuradha Pundir have been posted to Prayagraj from Shahjahanpur, while Manish Nigam and Poonam Dwitiya have been transferred from Unnao to Ghaziabad. Ajay Kumar and Parul Verma have been moved from Pratapgarh to Meerut. Several other couples have also been accommodated at the same locations. Special postings: Several judges have been assigned key roles in the High Court, Judicial Training and Research Institute (JTRI), Lucknow Bench, tribunals, and government departments. These include positions such as Registrar (Judicial), Additional Director at JTRI, Special Secretary, and Additional Law Officer. See the list... Maximum transfers across key UP districts: Agra, Aligarh, Bareilly, Gorakhpur, Lucknow, Prayagraj among most affected The Allahabad High Court administration carried out large-scale transfers across most districts of Uttar Pradesh, with Agra, Aligarh, Bareilly, Gorakhpur, Lucknow, Prayagraj, Kanpur Nagar, Varanasi, Meerut and Ghaziabad witnessing the highest movement of judicial officers. In total, 711 judicial officers were reshuffled on Sunday. This includes 266 Additional District and Sessions Judges, 169 Civil Judges (Senior Division), and 276 Civil Judges (Junior Division), marking one of the biggest administrative overhauls in recent times.

stories.title: Teen dies after drowning at temple pond:Playing on stairs before fall; NDRF recovers body, family protests
stories.summary: A 13-year-old boy died on Sunday after drowning in a pond built near the Karmdeshwar Mahadev Temple in Varanasi. The incident occurred when the boy was playing on the steps of the pond with his two friends. He lost balance and eventually landed in deep water. Local people said that even after two hours of hard effort when the boy was not found, National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) was called, which found the boy Pawan Prajapati in 20 minutes, who had died due to drowning. When the police took possession of the body and tried to send it for post-mortem, there was an altercation with the family members and villagers, and the family members left with the body. They did not want a post-mortem. After the station in-charge explained, the family members agreed to the post-mortem. See four pictures related to the incident Three friends had come to play in afternoon A local resident said - In the afternoon, three friends reached the pond located near Karmdeshwar Mahadev temple. The steps of the pond here have moss on them. While slipping on it, Pawan Prajapati (13), a resident of Kandwa area, went into the deep pond. Seeing this, his companions started screaming and a crowd gathered, but by then Pawan had already submerged in the deep water. Police reached the spot and sent divers into the water to search for the teenager. Location could not be traced even after two hours of effort For two hours, divers kept searching for Pawan in Kandwa pond but could not find any trace of him. Meanwhile, on the banks of the pond, the family members were in a terrible state, crying inconsolably. The administration then informed the NDRF. After the NDRF divers arrived, they found Pawan within 20 minutes of effort, but by then Pawan had already died. Foam was coming out of his nose and mouth. Were not ready for post-mortem Seeing their son's body, the father, mother and other family members started wailing loudly. After this, when the police tried to take possession of the body, the family members refused the post-mortem. This led to a sharp argument between the police and the family members. The family members started walking towards home with the body, but the police stopped them midway, explained to them, and took possession of the body to send it for post-mortem.

stories.title: Sunanda Sharma forgives student who rushed stage in Ghaziabad:Fan apologises after scare; singer urges leniency from authorities
stories.summary: A student from Rajkumar Goel Institute of Technology (RKGIT), Ghaziabad, who ran onto the stage to approach Punjabi singer Sunanda Sharma on April 3, has issued a public apology. On Sunday, he was seen holding his ears—a common gesture of remorse—while asking for forgiveness. Identifying himself as Shivang Pandey, the student said he is a devoted fan and acted impulsively while the singer was performing. “I suddenly went on stage to touch her feet. I apologize… If you forgive me, the college management will also forgive me,” he said. Singer responds, urges leniency Sunanda Sharma also shared a video on Instagram addressing the incident. She confirmed that she has forgiven the student and appealed to the college administration to take a softer approach. She acknowledged that while fans often express admiration in different ways, such actions can be alarming. “What the student did frightened me, especially given the kind of incidents happening with performers these days,” she said. The singer added that she had no prior indication of the student’s sudden arrival on stage. She admitted feeling scared at the moment, which led to a strong reaction, and said she briefly left the stage due to security concerns. Appeal for understanding and responsible behaviour Sunanda emphasized that while the student’s intentions may not have been harmful, the manner of expression was inappropriate. She urged authorities not to punish him harshly, stating that since she has forgiven him, the administration should also consider doing the same. She also advised fans to express admiration in a respectful way that does not inconvenience or endanger others. Thanking her supporters, she credited her success to their continued love and encouragement. Student reiterates apology In a separate video, Shivang again apologised directly to the singer. “My intention was not wrong. I did not mean to hurt you. I hope you forgive me so the college management will also forgive me,” he said. What happened on stage Student breaches security During the performance, while Sunanda was engaging the audience, students were recording videos and taking selfies near the stage. Amid this, Shivang managed to bypass security and climbed onto the stage unnoticed. Singer startled as student approaches He quickly moved towards the singer and attempted to touch her feet, which startled her. Sunanda screamed in fear, prompting immediate intervention from security personnel, who escorted her away. Brief disruption before removal Following the incident, the student remained on stage momentarily, even striking a pose with arms spread, before security and police intervened. He was eventually removed and taken into custody for questioning. Show cancelled after incident The disruption led to the event being called off due to security concerns. Sunanda Sharma left the venue and did not return to continue the performance, despite repeated requests from students.

stories.title: Yogi Adityanath calls Syed Salar Masud a mafia figure:Says, 'Suheldev sent him to hell, punished him with Islam’s harshest death on hot griddle'
stories.summary: CM Yogi said in Lucknow on Sunday everyone should know the valour shown by Maharaja Suheldev a thousand years ago. He not only stopped the foreign invader who broke the Somnath temple but also gave him such a brutal death that no one dared repeat it. Yogi said, “Salar Masud (Ghazi Mian) was no less than a mafia. He was like the mafias who have now been reduced to dust. He had broken our temples. Maharaja Suheldev gave him a death considered the worst in Islam. He was tied to a hot iron griddle and burned.” Yogi said—it is believed that such a death in Islam guarantees going to hell. Maharaja Suheldev ensured he would go to hell. Until we treat oppressors in this manner, they will continue to treat India's culture the same way. Yogi was speaking at the inauguration of the Golden Jubilee Drama Festival marking 50 years of the Bharatendu Natya Academy (BNA). He inaugurated the academy building and two auditoriums, honoured artists and students, and released the magazine ‘Rangbhed’. See Photos- 3. Where Salar Masood was killed, a fair was held in his name Yogi said- Indian society had forgotten Maharaja Suheldev. Our government built his memorial. If this is not slavery, then what is it? At the place where the Maharaja killed Salar Masood, a Masood fair used to be held. There was no mention of Suheldev. The Maharaja's contribution was not remembered by anyone. But now people visit Maharaja Suheldev's memorial. 4. 'Organized a program for Maharaja Suheldev while being an MP from Gorakhpur' The CM said that when I was an MP from Gorakhpur. We had organized a program in Bahraich on the Vijayotsav (victory celebration) of Maharaja Suheldev. When I was going there, the administration tried to stop me. But, I still went. At that time, there wasn't much crowd at the event. A large number of people were going to Salar Masood's fair. Why were they going to the fair of someone who came to crush them? But, now times have changed. Today I feel good. The crowd now goes to Maharaja Suheldev's memorial instead. No one even peeks into Salar Masood's fair. 5. 'Those who trampled India's culture should not be honored' The CM said - There is no play, no music on Maharaja Suheldev. We should create something on them. Music and plays should be made on Veerangana Avantibai, Veerangana Udadevi, Veerangana Jhalkaribai, Maharaja Bijli Pasi. The Drama Academy should create short plays. So that children will consider them their heroes. The villains who trampled India's culture should never be honored. The story of Maharaja Suheldev Maharaja Suheldev was born in Shravasti in 990 AD. According to Mirat-e-Masoodi, a Persian language text written in the 17th century, Suheldev was the eldest son of King Mordhwaj of Shravasti. In various versions of legends, he is known by different names including Sakardev, Suhiradhwaj, Suhridil, Suhridaladhwaj, Rai Suhrid Dev, Susaj, and Suhardal. According to the Awadh Gazetteer, his reign lasted from 1027 to 1077 AD. His kingdom was mainly spread across Bahraich and Shravasti districts, with its expansion said to have extended to Gorakhpur in the east and Sitapur in the west. Parmeshwar Singh, former spokesperson of KV Inter College Payagpur, Bahraich, had provided detailed information about Maharaja Suheldev 8 years ago. According to him, about 3 kilometers north of Bahraich city, there was a huge Suryakund (sun pond) and a grand Sun Temple. A Mahatma named Balark Rishi lived there. He was the guru of Maharaja Suheldev. Suheldev had special proficiency in archery, firing sound-piercing arrows, swordsmanship, mace, and spear throwing. He also had a passion for swimming in the river. Hunting lions with arrows and swords was a common thing for him. As per the Guru's command, no woman other than his mother could come near him until the age of 25. He was a ruler of high caliber. During his time, people did not feel the need to lock their houses. He gave a beautiful form to the city of Shravasti. Maharaja Suheldev's Memorial Built by the Lake Chittaura Lake is located 8 km from Bahraich district headquarters on Gonda Road. A memorial to Maharaja Suheldev has been built on the banks of the lake. A 40-foot-high bronze statue of Maharaja Suheldev has been installed here. It is claimed that this statue is the country's largest statue of Maharaja Suheldev riding a horse standing on two legs. This statue was constructed under the supervision of the Uttar Pradesh State Lalit Kala Akademi. It was created by sculptor Padma Shri Ram Sutar. The foundation stone of the memorial was laid by PM Narendra Modi via video conferencing on February 16, 2021. Now know about Syed Salar Masood Ghazi

stories.title: Former Lok Sabha Speaker recalls facing untouchability in Lucknow:Says leader invited her for breakfast, woman inside objected using caste remark
stories.summary: I have also faced untouchabilitymy mother also suffered during her studies, and my father could not escape it even while holding a top political position. This is what Meira Kumar, who was the Speaker of the Lok Sabha during the Congress rule, said. At the Samta Diwas program organized in Lucknow on the birth anniversary of her father Babu Jagjivan Ram, she said- When my mother went to college after completing her school education, she was told that they would not teach an untouchable. A leader invited me for breakfast. From inside, a woman said that if they fed these untouchables, they would have to break the plate. Read the highlights of Meira Kumar's address 'Mother faced untouchability in Lucknow' Meira Kumar said, My maternal grandparents' home is in Kanpur. My maternal grandfather, Dr. Veerbal, was a very prominent doctor in Kanpur. In 1911, when the plague spread, everyone fled, but he did not. He would have lime put in wells, arrange for the burial of the dead, and treat those who survived. My mother, Indrani Devi, completed her schooling in Kanpur. After completing her schooling, when she went to college, she was told - 'We will not educate the daughter of an untouchable.' My father sent her to Lucknow. My mother completed her higher education here, staying in a hostel for 4 years, but even here, she was treated with untouchability. 'Even being in Congress, I couldn't escape untouchability' Meira Kumar said- I am Babu Ji's daughter, I was in the Foreign Service. I have been in Congress for so long, yet I couldn't escape it. I went to Chennai. There, a leader invited me for breakfast at his house. There were 4 other people with me. When we arrived, some voices were coming from inside. The people with me stood up and said, "Sister, let's go from here, we won't stay here for even a minute." Inside, a woman was saying that all untouchables are sitting. After feeding them, we will have to break all the plates. We will not eat. I said, 'Sit down, and if you don't listen to restrictions elsewhere, then eat here. If someone is inviting you with so much love and feeding you dosa, halwa, idli, sambar, then eat it. They will break their own plates, why are you worrying?' The 1978 Banaras Incident and the Reply of Ravidas Temple Referring to the incident of January 24, 1978, Meira Kumar said - Babu Ji was invited to Banaras for the unveiling of Sampurnanand's statue. During the unveiling, there was insulting behavior and slogans were raised in protest. He quietly returned. This was debated in the Rajya Sabha-Parliament. A condemnation motion was passed. But my Babu Ji did not say anything. My mother also asked why he was not saying anything? A year later in 1979, my father told mother that he had thought of a reply to the Banaras incident. Mother was surprised that he thought of a reply after a year. Then she asked back what reply he had thought of. Father replied - I have bought land on the banks of the Ganga, I will build a very large Ravidas temple there. This is my offering in return for what Banaras gave me. Referring to the temple, he said - In this temple, high ideals are worshipped. The sayings of great saints are inscribed on marble. In all four corners, symbols of different religions - temple, mosque, church, Buddhist monastery - are all built. Babuji backed down in honor of women Meira Kumar said that after independence, a movement began for the entry of women into temples. Regarding this, Babuji was leading the Temple Liberation Movement. He was opening temples for women with harmony. Babuji also reached Banaras to open the Kashi Vishwanath Temple for women. Some people were protesting. However, their number was very small. Early in the morning, Babuji received a call asking what to do? The protesters had laid down women from their homes in the alleys leading to the temple. We cannot go by stepping over them. Babuji said that respecting women is greater than seeing God, come back. 'There is still much to be done' In the end, Meira Kumar asked the assembly - There is still trouble, pain is caused. Wherever I go, I ask my Dalit brothers - Has untouchability ended? They say yes, we have separated the handpump. There is still much to be done. Appealing to the pioneers and young workers of Congress, she said, 'You move forward. Bring revolution. Change society. My truth is not sweet, it is bitter.' She asked the assembly - Will you fight this unfinished battle?" Hearing the echo of 'yes' from the crowd, she said, Then this will be a true tribute to Babu Ji.

stories.title: Shankaracharya asks why Mohan Bhagwat doesn’t marry and have children:Says we will stand with whoever listens to us
stories.summary: We had said that Mohan Bhagwat and his propagandists should come, get married, have children, and increase the population. On one hand, the government is saying that there is a population explosion. On the other hand, these people talk about increasing the population. If increasing the population is so important, then why don't you get married and have children? Why do you burden others? Do it yourself first, then tell others. Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati said these things during a press conference in Bareilly on Sunday. He was responding to a question related to the RSS chief's statement about having 3 children. In fact, Bhagwat has said many times that it is necessary for Hindus to have three children. Last month, during his visit to Mathura, Bhagwat had also said - Doctors believe that if a family has three children, the chances of parents and children being healthy increase. As psychology states, when there are three children in a home, they grow up to develop better and balanced personalities. Mutual quarrels and conflicts also decrease. On the question of supporting the opposition, Shankaracharya said that the ruling party says that we are with the opposition. I want to tell them to listen to us. Make laws for the protection of mother cow. We will stand with you. I am not with any party or opposition. Whoever listens to us, I will stand with them. 'I am surprised to see scholars silent on the America-Israel war' During a press conference at Devbhoomi Industrial Training Institute, Swami Avimukteshwaranand said - When there is a war, there are always two sides, one of justice and the other of injustice. For example, today one side is America and Israel, and the other is Iran. It is surprising that scholars all over the world are silent on this issue. This is a crime against humanity. Shankaracharya said, what was Prime Minister Narendra Modi's reaction to the war. On this, I would not like to say anything, but it is the duty of a scholar to state that this person is committing injustice and this person is suffering injustice, because in war, both sides cannot be good. He said - India has been a non-aligned country from the beginning. India has never stood with anyone in war. This is the first time, due to the Prime Minister's silence, the question is arising in people's minds that he might be standing on someone's side. Shankaracharya said that the Prime Minister is openly in favor of the Jews. This puts us in a state of worry. Is India falling into the trap of the Jews? Due to the war, there is a shortage of gas cylinders, but the Prime Minister and Chief Minister are not aware of this, because there is no power cut at their residences. Nor is there any shortage of rations. For them, everything is fine, but the public is distressed. 'Vote on the issue of cow protection' Shankaracharya said that I had given the government a deadline to bring a law on the issue of cow protection, but my words were not heard. I would urge opposition leaders to inspire people to vote on the issue of cow protection. I would like to tell the public to vote on the issue of cow protection. He said that as soon as elections approach, issues like 'Love Jihad' and religious conversion will be brought forward to divert attention, but the public should not be diverted. They should only vote on their own issues. In Hinduism, the cow (Go-Mata) holds great importance. Whenever bread (roti) is made in Hindu homes, the first bread is offered to the cow. 'Going to Rishikesh, came to Bareilly at the committee's request' Shankaracharya said - We are traveling from Varanasi, via Delhi, to Rishikesh. The summer doors of Lord Badrinath are about to open. For that, according to tradition, the pot of sacred oil has arrived in Rishikesh from the royal family. Now, from Rishikesh, it will be dispatched on April 8 for Badrinath Ji, via Jyotirmath. This is a tradition. He informed - This time, the committee had requested us to come. We are going for that. While traveling, it occurred to us that Bareilly is a city of religion. The way the scholars here have always connected people to Sanatan Dharma. We like that. That's why we have stopped in Bareilly.

stories.title: Family cuts ties with burqa-clad robbery accused woman:Father-in-law says ‘we are ashamed’; house locked in Ayodhya, family in Punjab
stories.summary: 'We had no idea that our daughter-in-law could do something like this. She has shamed us. Now there is no relationship with her; we will not bring her home.' This is what Hariram, the father-in-law of Payal (25), the woman who robbed a jewellery shop in Ayodhya wearing a burqa, said. He works and lives in Punjab. When asked about his daughter-in-law, he expressed displeasure. He said that after his son went to work, Payal would leave the house without informing anyone. She would remain missing for hours. When questioned, she would start arguing back. She would talk on the phone for a long time, but it was not clear with whom she was speaking. Dainik Bhaskar's team reached Payal's in-laws' house, where they found it locked. The father-in-law provided several important pieces of information about Payal during a phone conversation. Married a year ago, stayed together for a short time Bhaskar's team reached Subba village, Kotia, Payal's in-laws' house. The house was locked. Villagers said that all family members live in Punjab. They do labor and tailoring work. No one in the village had any inkling of this incident. The father-in-law is a mason by profession. We got the number of Payal's father-in-law, Hariram, from the villagers. In a phone conversation, Hariram said - Payal was married to his son Deepu last April. Deepu works as a tailor with his elder brother in Moga, Punjab. After marriage, Payal could only stay at her in-laws' house for a very short time, about 3 months. Illness and controversies were discussed Whenever Payal came to Punjab, she often complained of being ill, but as soon as she went to her maternal home, she would get well. Her behavior was not normal in her in-laws' house, and she used to constantly argue with her elder sister-in-law over small matters. See Payal's pictures Good behaviour with husband and children After the incident, there are various discussions in the village, but no one is openly willing to say anything. The father-in-law says that Payal's behavior with her husband was good. She used to cook food on time and her attitude towards the children of the house was also fine. She had come to her maternal home in Ayodhya, Mathana Nivada's Ahibaran Ka Purwa village, to take her intermediate examination on March 16. Read the full story in detail Arrived wearing a burqa to buy a gold necklace-chain Mahesh, a jeweler, resides in Kothi Bazar Mohalla of Rudauli area. His shop, named Mahesh Jewelers, is located in Agarwal Complex, 900 meters away from his home. On April 2, Thursday afternoon, a girl wearing a burqa arrived at the shop. She had a backpack. The girl said, "I want to buy a gold necklace and chain." Mahesh showed her a gold necklace and chain. During this, the girl asked for water. Mahesh sent Ankit, who works in the shop, to bring water and samosa. When Ankit brought the samosa and water, Payal refused to eat. She said, "I don't eat samosas. Please order sweets." Mahesh sent Ankit to get barfi. During this, the shop employee Maniram picked up the necklace and chain and placed them on the counter. Then the girl stood up and started wandering around inside the shop. Mahesh asked - What's the matter? The girl replied - My husband went to withdraw money, he hasn't returned, I'm just looking for him. Then she came and stood near the counter. Mahesh started putting other jewelry in the cupboard, just then Payal picked up the gold necklace and chain kept in the box. She picked up her bag. Showing a pistol, she said - I will shoot you. When shopkeeper Mahesh interrupted, she pulled out a pistol from her waist. Pointing it at Mahesh, she said, 'If you move forward, I will shoot you.' After that, she ran out of the shop. Mahesh and Maniram chased her, shouting. She ran out of the shop on foot and fled with a young man who was waiting on a bike a short distance away. Mahesh said that the jewellery was 26 grams (22 carat). According to the market price on April 2, its value was approximately 3 lakh 60 thousand rupees. Mahesh immediately informed the police. 60 CCTV footage was extracted, then the vehicle number was found The daylight robbery caused a stir in the police. Police formed 5 teams and started the investigation. 60 CCTV cameras in the vicinity were scanned. The footage showed that the girl left on a motorcycle with a young man. The bike's number was extracted, through which the location was traced. Police first reached Paran Ka Purwa. There, Rahul was identified. Police arrested Rahul. During interrogation, Rahul revealed that a girl named Payal was also with him. After this, Payal was arrested the same night from Ahibaran Ka Purwa village in Mathana Nivada. Police, while revealing the incident, recovered the stolen jewelry and a fake pistol. Both accused have been arrested and sent to jail. Rahul was unemployed, used to visit Payal's village Rahul's family, a resident of Paran Ka Purwa, is economically weak. His father Radheshyam has passed away. He is the youngest of 3 brothers. Elder brother Lavkush stays at home. One brother, Bablu, works as a laborer in Delhi. Rahul lives separately with his mother but does no work. The distance from Payal's house to his house is about 16 km. They came into contact due to his frequent visits to the village.

stories.title: Mastermind in Kanpur kidney scam claims huge money:Audio recording with agent recovered, Kannauj doctor caught
stories.summary: Police have found an audio recording from the mobile phone of Shivam Agarwal, the mastermind of Kanpur's infamous kidney scam. According to DCP West SM Qasim Abidi, he had sent this recording to Naveen Pandey, a resident of Prayagraj, who was part of the gang. In the audio, Naveen is mentioning Sahil, a broker from Prayagraj, to Shivam. He says that Sahil has taken 22 lakh rupees using your name. To this, Shivam says - he doesn't know what Shivam and Dr. Rohit are, we just throw away crores of rupees like that. Meanwhile, the police team reached Naveen Pandey's house in Prayagraj on Saturday evening, but he was not found. Meanwhile, the police called Shivam's wife to Rawatpur police station for questioning. She stated that Naveen has been working with Dr. Rohit, a resident of Ghaziabad, for 4-5 years. Shivam had only been associated with Dr. Rohit for one year. Police will file a petition in the district court on Monday, seeking Shivam's remand. According to the police, this recording is from December last year. However, the police have not made it public. So far, 9 people have been arrested in the kidney scam. Kannauj Doctor Detained by Police According to the police, Shivam is mentioning a woman in the recording. He says that the woman we brought to Delhi, who was admitted to Max Hospital in Dwarka, died. To this, Naveen says that the woman should have been taken by ambulance, but you people took her in a Scorpio. Does a Scorpio have any medical facilities? According to the police, the woman mentioned in the audio underwent a kidney transplant at Medilife Hospital in December. After this, her health deteriorated. She was immediately admitted to Max Hospital in Delhi, where she died. Police have taken Dr. Rohan, a resident of Kannauj, into custody on Saturday in connection with the woman's death. He is being interrogated. The hospital's two other partners, Dr. Narendra, a resident of Auraiya, and Dr. Sandeep from Kannauj, are currently absconding. Sahil defrauded 20 lakh in the name of kidney Police Commissioner Raghubir Lal said that like Shivam Agarwal, Sahil also worked for Dr. Rohit. The investigation revealed that a woman needed a kidney. Sahil contacted her and said that Dr. Rohit charges 40 lakh for a transplant, but he would arrange a kidney transplant for 20 lakh rupees. After this, he took 20 lakh rupees from the woman and absconded. The Police Commissioner said that raids are being conducted in Chitrakoot and Prayagraj in search of Sahil. So far, none of the doctors whose names have come forward in the gang are surgeons. The gang includes Dr. Rohit, an anesthesiologist, Dr. Vaibhav, a dentist, Dr. Anurag, Alpha Hospital operator, Dr. Afzal, a physician, and Dr. Ali, an OT technician. BA pass Bhupendra became a Doctor of Medicine The DCP said that Shivam's wife was interrogated for about 6 hours on Friday. During this, she named Bhupendra Singh, the manager of Ramashiv Hospital located opposite Hallet. Bhupendra Singh was in contact with Dr. Rohit. When the police interrogated him, he revealed that he had built a private hospital in Lucknow, opposite SGPGI. According to DCP West, Bhupendra's visiting card had MD (Doctor of Medicine) written on it. When asked, he stated that MD stands for Managing Director. He was in contact with Dr. Rohit. Dr. Rohit had asked him to get a kidney transplant done at his hospital, but he did not undergo the transplant. The operators of Medilife, Rohan, Narendra, and Ajay, are also being interrogated. Meerut's travel agent used to book cars under fake names Dr. Anurag alias Amit had two marriages The police team reached Meerut in search of Dr. Anurag, who is linked to the scandal. The investigation revealed that Meerut's Alpha Hospital is in Dr. Anurag's name. He is a physiotherapist and has married twice. The police team reached his first wife's house, but he was not found there. The police are searching for his second wife's location. Now know the connection to Medilife Hospital DCP Abidi stated that OT technicians Rajesh Kumar and Kuldeep Singh Raghav had said during interrogation that they had performed all operations at Ahuja Hospital, but an examination of their mobile phones revealed numbers of several other hospitals in the city. This includes Medilife Hospital located in Maswanpur.

stories.title: Fake note mastermind’s political ties questioned:BJP MLA attended event, SP flags found in his house and vehicle
stories.summary: Politics has erupted over Vivek Yadav, the mastermind behind fake notes in UP. BJP leaders are calling him a Samajwadi, while SP leaders are proving the accused to be a BJP member. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav targeted BJP MLA Shalabhmani from Deoria. Asked - When will he be interrogated? How far is Deoria from Gorakhpur? Pictures of Vivek Yadav with Shalabhmani were also posted. On the other hand, Shalabhmani and other BJP members are posting pictures on social media to prove Vivek is an SP leader. After Vivek's name came up in the fake currency case, leaders of both parties are also distancing themselves. The question arises, which party is Vivek Yadav from Deoria actually associated with? Read this in Sunday Big Story Photo with MLA, Samajwadi Party said - Vivek belongs to BJP This case began with the action of Deoria police on April 30. Two boys each from Bhadohi and Deoria were caught with fake notes worth 1.80 lakh rupees. These boys worked for Vivek Yadav of Deoria. It came to light that fake notes of 500, 200, and 100 rupees were being printed in Deoria and spread across Uttar Pradesh. As soon as Vivek Yadav's name came up in this case, local BJP leaders in Deoria became active on social media. Vivek's pictures were posted with captions saying that he is a 'Sapayi' (SP supporter)... he campaigns for SP. Like Atiq in the film 'Dhurandhar', he was circulating fake notes in UP. This is where politics began in the entire matter. On April 1, the SP media cell shared 4 pictures. In these, the arrested boys were seen with MLA Shalabhmani. The post asked why there are pictures of these boys with MLA Shalabhmani. The BJP and the government's administration are making a hue and cry about these boys who were circulating fake notes, will BJP leaders explain what these boys were doing with Shalabhmani? Will Shalabhmani be questioned in the fake notes case? Akhilesh asked - Why the delay in action? After SP's X handle, party chief Akhilesh Yadav also wrote on social media- Pictures of those circulating fake notes have been found with a BJP MLA, from the street to his office, as evidence. Then why the delay in taking action against them? Bhaskar spoke to Deoria's BJP MLA Shalabhmani Tripathi Question. Did you attend Vivek Yadav's event? Your photo with him has surfaced. Shalabhamani. I am the MLA here; every day in the morning, people come to us and present their issues. One day, Vivek Yadav came to invite us to a program related to the installation of the idol of Kali Maa in his village. He also took a photo with me. We attended that program. In these programs, we don't look at who belongs to SP or who belongs to BJP. We always reach out to people. Question. Is Vivek a supporter of BJP or SP? Shalabhamani. Look at Vivek's complete profile, and you will clearly see that he is associated with SP. Despite this, Akhilesh Yadav is linking him to BJP, whereas at such a time, he should have explained to his workers to stay away from such activities. Work for the party. But he is washing his hands of the matter by calling his own worker a member of another party. Deoria SP District President said - Vivek has no position in the party To understand Vivek Yadav's political affiliation more closely, Bhaskar also spoke to Vyas Yadav, the SP District President of Deoria. We asked - Does Vivek hold any position in the SP? He says - this person is neither an office bearer of SP nor a general worker. He has no association with the party at any level. All this appears to be a well-thought-out conspiracy to tarnish the image of SP. The accused is associated with some influential leaders of other political parties, but those people are linking the accused to SP out of political malice, which is absolutely wrong.

stories.title: 4 suspects arrested in Lucknow after ATS probe:Pakistan handler Abu Bakar paid ₹12K per arson
stories.summary: Four suspected terrorists were arrested in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. During ATS questioning, it came out they had an offer from Pakistan to spread terror for money. The suspects were told the more fear they created, the more money they would get. To plan a big blast, they carried out a rehearsal by setting a pickup truck and a bike on fire. They sent videos of these acts to a Pakistani handler, Abu Bakar, and received 12 thousand rupees for each arson. On Saturday, all four accused were presented before a special court in Lucknow. UP ATS was granted 5-day remand of Shakib, Vikas Gehlawat, Lokesh alias Papla Pandit, and Arbab. During this period, ATS will interrogate them about the tasks given by the Pakistani handler. AK-47 belongs to Akib of Dubai ADG Law and Order Amitabh Yash says, ‘This is a sensitive matter. The age group of these boys is between 19 and 27 years. These boys are masters in Google search, they gather information by searching for material very quickly. Among the four boys, Saqib was giving directions to everyone.’ He was getting help from his brother Akib in Dubai. Saqib told ATS that the AK-47 he is holding in the photo, belongs to his brother Akib, who lives in Dubai. Several pictures of Akib with an AK-47 have also been found. Now ATS is trying to find out where Akib got this AK-47 from. Many videos of arson, location and timing being ascertained So far, the investigation has revealed that these people had set fire to a pickup truck and made videos of it a month ago on March 4. This arson took place in the Kiratpur area. Seven mobile phones found with the four boys contained more such videos, and we are currently checking their locations to determine when and where these incidents occurred. Burnt vehicles are not investigated, they took advantage of this Amitabh Yash says, ‘Records of arson incidents in vehicles, shops, and small establishments in the districts of Bulandshahr, Bijnor, Meerut, Baghpat, Hapur in West UP over the last 6 months are being reviewed to ascertain what connection these four have with these incidents. Investigating agencies believe that these boys were doing this because vehicles have insurance, and after burning them, they were not investigated much.’ They contacted Pakistan in 2 ways, most numbers from Afghanistan Amitabh Yash said, ‘During the investigation, it also came to light that these people contacted Abu Bakar of Pakistan in 2 ways.’ 1. They used the Signal app for calling. 2. They used Instagram to send documents and video files. They used VPN so they wouldn't get caught. This is why, when tracing IP addresses, most numbers appear to be from Afghanistan's location. Found in YouTube's search history - how to make a chemical bomb In the YouTube search history of Shakib and Arbab's mobiles, it was found: how to make a time bomb, how to make a chemical bomb, and what are the techniques for accurate targeting? They have also watched many videos, and Abu Bakar sent them some links and videos. How much these people were able to learn will only become clear after 5 days of remand. Videos of military bases were made and sent to Pakistan Interrogation of the arrested suspected terrorists revealed that they had collected information about military bases in UP. Videos of the cantonment areas were prepared. This information was also sent to Pakistan. It is being said that Hindu leaders of UP were also on their target. The suspected terrorists had also gathered information about their movements. How did ATS reach these four boys? ATS sources say - On March 4, 2026, Nimish Rastogi's pickup van was set on fire in Bijnor. Police arrested Abuzar and Zaid in connection with it on March 12. According to the police, Abuzar was struggling with financial difficulties. He sought help from his cousin Mohammad Zaid. Zaid connected him to Abu Bakar via the Telegram app. Abu Bakar gave directions to set Hindu vehicles on fire. After this, Abuzar set fire to the van near the temple, recorded a video of the incident, and sent it to Abu Bakar via Telegram. After this, money was transferred to his account. Evidence was found that Zaid was connected to 12 different groups. Both UP ATS and NIA are investigating this matter. During this investigation, Saqib's links to Abubakar were also found, after which ATS put Saqib's mobile number under surveillance and started tracking him.

stories.title: Student dies after accidental gunshot while filming reel:Was loading bullet into pistol himself; family alleges murder
stories.summary: A 12th-grade student in Lakhimpur was fatally injured while making a reel with a pistol. During the recording, the gun suddenly discharged, and the bullet struck him in the stomach, causing him to collapse in pain. In an attempt to control the bleeding, he pressed the wound with both hands. As his condition worsened, his friends rushed him to the hospital, where he later succumbed to his injuries. The incident had taken place on 30 March, though the video of the incident surfaced on Friday. In the footage, the student can be seen loading a bullet into the pistol moments before it accidentally fires, after which he falls. Following the incident, the family lodged a complaint with the police, alleging that their son had been kidnapped and murdered. Based on their complaint, the police have registered a case against several unidentified individuals, along with two named suspects. Two youths have been taken into custody for questioning. The incident falls under the Sadar Kotwali police station area. See two photos related to the incident Anil Kumar Jha lives with his family in Suagara village. He told the police that his son, Ansh Kumar Jha (17 years old), had left home at 8 PM on March 30 with friends. Late at night, Ansh called. The son informed that he had gone to Lucknow to get treatment for a friend's mother. The next morning, he called again and said he was returning from Lucknow. On March 31, at around 2:30 PM, Ansh called again and said he was unwell. He had been admitted to Janshakti Hospital, Gola Road, Lakhimpur. As soon as the information was received, family members reached the hospital. Here, Ansh's friends Shubham Kumar and Nitin Singh alias Mikku, along with other companions, were present. The family members allege that Ansh's friends and the hospital staff did not give them the correct information. When asked, they were told that Ansh had been burned by firecrackers. Due to this, his treatment was ongoing. On the night of March 31, at around 1 AM, doctors called the family members and informed them about Ansh's deteriorating condition. They advised taking him to Lucknow. Father came to know about the bullet injury in Lucknow Father Anil Kumar Jha took his son Ansh to Ram Manohar Lohiya Hospital in Lucknow. There, an X-ray examination revealed that Ansh had a bullet in his stomach. During treatment, his condition continued to deteriorate. He died around 6 AM on April 2. Family members say that if the correct information had been received on time, Ansh's life could have been saved with better treatment. Based on the complaint, police have registered a report naming Shubham Kumar and Nitin Singh, along with several unknown persons. Allegations of kidnapping, murder, and concealing evidence Ansh's uncle, Sunil Kumar alias Sonu, has alleged that Ansh was kidnapped and murdered. Later, attempts were made to conceal evidence. He says that several other people may also be involved in this incident. He has demanded an impartial investigation and justice from the police. Had taken admission in 12th Ansh Kumar Jha's grandfather, Dev Lakhan Jha, is retired from Uttar Pradesh Police. Ansh was a student of the city's Dharmasabha Inter College. After passing class 11th, he took admission in 12th this year. The entire family, including mother Renu Jha, brother Vansh Jha, and grandmother Ratan Mala Jha, is in shock over the son's death. Police are interrogating two friends taken into custody.

stories.title: Heavy hailstorm in Kanpur-Jalaun and Lalitpur:Several trees uprooted, wall collapses, vehicles damaged due to storm; drizzle in Lucknow
stories.summary: The weather has deteriorated once again in UP. Heavy hailstorms occurred in Kanpur, Lalitpur, and Jalaun. In Kanpur, there was rain accompanied by strong winds on Saturday evening. Several trees were uprooted in Govind Nagar here. A car was completely crushed under a fallen tree. Power supply has also been affected. Weather expert Dr. S.N. Sunil Pandey from Kanpur said that the weather may remain bad until April 5. Meanwhile, in Jalaun's Madhogarh tehsil, there was heavy rain with strong winds. Heavy hailstones also fell. A sheet of hail covered the roads and fields. The standing wheat and mustard crops in the fields were destroyed. The Meteorological Department has issued an orange alert in Lucknow. In the next few hours, there is a possibility of storms, rain, and thunderstorms at speeds of 40 to 60 kilometers per hour. Light drizzle has already started. Since Saturday morning, clouds have covered 20 cities, including Meerut-Ghaziabad. Strong winds are blowing. Alert for rain and hailstorms in 35 districts today See 3 pictures of Kanpur... Drizzle in Lucknow Heavy hailstorm in Jalaun Hailstorm in Lalitpur 5 deaths in 48 hours Hailstorm occurred in Agra late Friday night. Rain occurred in Mathura and Sambhal. A tree fell due to a storm in Kasganj. A brother and sister, standing underneath to take shelter from the rain, died after being crushed. In Mathura, rain soaked 5 thousand quintals of wheat stored in 10 thousand sacks at the Kosi Kalan grain market. In Agra, 5 mud houses collapsed. Meanwhile, 5 people have died in the state due to lightning strikes in 48 hours. These include a government teacher and his wife in Varanasi, 2 people from Chitrakoot, and one person from Lalitpur. Lucknow weather scientist Atul Singh said - A new spell of unseasonal rain has started due to the western disturbance that became active from April 3 and westerly winds bringing moisture from the Arabian Sea. A new western disturbance is becoming active from April 7. Its impact will be more visible in western UP, central region and Bundelkhand. Strong winds will blow. There will be rain. Hail will fall. Temperature will drop by 5C. See pictures of yesterday's weather- Why did the weather change again? Lucknow Meteorological Department scientist Atul Kumar Singh said that the effect of the western disturbance active in southern Afghanistan and surrounding Pakistani areas has now started showing in Uttar Pradesh. Due to this, the weather has deteriorated in western UP. Heavy rain is occurring with strong winds. Now its effect will reach the central region and Bundelkhand. Strong gusty winds will blow in many areas. Now know the condition of cities What will the weather be like for 5 days? 5 died due to a lightning strike, 2 died in storm Crops damaged by unseasonal rain and strong winds Crops have suffered significant damage due to unseasonal rain and strong winds. CM Yogi had inquired about the condition of affected farmers. He had sought reports from officials. All district magistrates were instructed to remain in alert mode. He said that farmers should not face any kind of trouble. Assess crop damage and ensure compensation to farmers soon. 15,000 farmers' crops damaged in 15 days According to the UP government, in the last 15 days, crops of 15,000 farmers spread over 4,300 hectares have been damaged. So far, 10,278 farmers have received compensation.

stories.title: Lucknow blast plot accused terrorist sent on 5-day remand:Pak connection-terror network to be interrogated; 4 youth caught by ATS
stories.summary: The four accused of the terrorist module caught in Lucknow were presented in court on Saturday, from where they were sent on a 5-day police remand. UP ATS will now interrogate them about Pakistani handlers and the terrorist network. ATS commandos presented the four accused, Shakib, Vikas Gahlawat, Lokesh alias Papla Pandit, and Arbab in the special court of Lucknow in the afternoon. Their custody remand was sought, which the court accepted and handed them over to ATS for 5 days. Conspiracy to carry out blasts in several cities, including Lucknow The preliminary investigation has revealed that the accused had conducted reconnaissance of railway property, prestigious institutions, and some political figures in cities like Lucknow, Ghaziabad, and Aligarh. The ATS is now verifying all these locations and assessing the potential threat. Trial of a bigger conspiracy through small attacks Investigation agencies suspect that the accused had demonstrated a 'trial' to their handlers by first carrying out small-scale arson incidents. They also received payments by sending videos of these incidents, which further boosted their confidence. After the case was exposed, the state's security agencies have been put on alert. Surveillance has been increased at sensitive locations so that any potential threat can be prevented in time. Important clues may be found from recovered items Inflammable materials, 7 smartphones, and several objectionable pamphlets have been recovered from the arrested accused. ATS is conducting a forensic examination of these digital devices, which is likely to yield important clues related to chats, transactions, and foreign contacts. Focus on investigating connections with Pakistani handlers According to ATS officials, the biggest focus during interrogation will be to understand the network connected to the accused's Pakistani handlers. It will also be ascertained through which mediums contact was being made and which locations were being targeted.

stories.title: Lakhs of teachers protest in Delhi against TET mandatory requirement:30 thousand teachers from UP joins; demands govt to bring ordinance
stories.summary: Around 30,000 teachers from Uttar Pradesh staged a protest at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan on Saturday against the mandatory TET requirement. Teachers from nearly 20 states, including Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh and Karnataka, also joined in large numbers. They raised slogans like “Remove TET, save teachers” and “We won’t let our rights be taken away.” The teachers submitted a memorandum addressed to Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the PMO, demanding an ordinance against the Supreme Court’s September 1, 2025, order. They also sought a law in Parliament to exempt teachers from the mandatory TET requirement. Teachers Federation of India national president Dr Dinesh Chandra Sharma said the Supreme Court’s decision could push lakhs of families into unemployment. He warned that if the Centre does not intervene, they will gherao Parliament. In September 2025, the Supreme Court made it mandatory for all teachers up to junior high school level across the country to pass the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET). The order has put the jobs of around 1.87 lakh teachers in Uttar Pradesh at risk. Teachers put forward two more demands Teachers who fail to clear TET by September 1, 2027, should not be dismissed, but treated as retired so they can receive a pension and benefits. Teachers appointed before August 23, 2010 (before the RTE Act came into force) should be completely exempt from TET. Dr Sharma said over 20 lakh teachers across the country are at risk due to the ruling, making it essential for the government to intervene and secure their livelihoods. UP Primary Teachers’ Association general secretary Sanjay Singh said TET was implemented in the state on July 27, 2011, and imposing it on those appointed earlier is unfair. Background of the case The Supreme Court bench of Justice Dipankar Datta and Justice Augustine George Masih, while hearing petitions from Tamil Nadu and Maharashtra, ruled that teachers with more than five years of service remaining must pass TET. Otherwise, they would have to resign or opt for compulsory retirement. The court also directed state governments to ensure all teachers clear the TET within two years. Several political parties, including the Samajwadi Party, raised the issue in Parliament, demanding relief through an ordinance, but the Centre declined, citing the court’s order. Following the decision, protests erupted across Uttar Pradesh. Two teachers, one in Hamirpur and another in Mahoba, reportedly died, with families claiming they were distressed after the ruling. Several states, including Uttar Pradesh, have filed review petitions, which are pending before the Supreme Court. If accepted, the original order could be stayed. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath had earlier said that teachers are experienced and trained by the government, and their capability should not be overlooked. In Uttar Pradesh, about 1.86 lakh teachers appointed before July 29, 2011, have not cleared TET. Around 50,000 of them are not even eligible to appear for the exam. These include teachers appointed with minimum qualifications, such as intermediate and BTC, dependent appointments, and BPEd-qualified physical education teachers. UP TET exam in July The UP TET 2026 exam will be held on July 2, 3 and 4. Applications began on March 27, with the last date set as April 26. The fee for General and OBC candidates has been increased to ₹2,000. The last date for corrections in the application form is May 1. The exam is being conducted after nearly four years; the previous exam in November 2021 was cancelled due to a paper leak and was later held in January 2022. Teachers took to the streets against the Supreme Court's order. Protests took place in all districts of UP.

stories.title: CM Mohan Yadav visits famous Kashi shop; asks ‘what’s special:Orders kachori-sabzi, lassi; urges people to watch Vikramaditya Mahanatya play
stories.summary: Madhya Pradesh CM Mohan Yadav remained in Varanasi for the second day. On Saturday morning, he along with his wife Seema Yadav, reached the city's famous Ram Bhandar shop. He asked the shopkeeper, "What will you serve? Listening to CM Yadav, the shopkeeper smiled. The CM then ordered Kachori and Lassi as he sat and had breakfast with common people. Despite the shopkeeper denying, CM Yadav himself paid the bill. After eating, CM Yadav conversed with the media. During the conversation, he said, “Do go and watch Vikramaditya Mahanatya play.” See pictures It is my good fortune that Baba called me twice in 7 days CM Mohan Yadav said, “By the grace of Baba Vishwanath, he got the opportunity to visit Kashi twice in 7 days. This is my good fortune. There is spiritual energy in the city. The CM also praised the great play based on Vikramaditya, organized in Kashi. He said, ”This performance is truly wonderful and whoever comes to Kashi must see it." On April 3, the grand theatrical performance of Vikramotsav 2026 was inaugurated On April 3, CM Yogi and Yadav inaugurated the grand theatrical performance of Vikramotsav 2026. During the event, CM Mohan Yadav also presented a Vedic clock to Yogi. Madhya Pradesh CM Mohan Yadav said, “What Chief Minister Yogiji said is very important. The pair of 3 brothers is famous in the world. The example of what kind of relationship should exist between brothers is found in the pair of Lord Shri Krishna and Balram ji. Similarly, the pair of Bhartrihari and Maharaj Vikramaditya is equally famous.” In the tradition of Vikramaditya, Maharaja Bhartrihari became established in the Nath Sampradaya. Ujjain was the land of his initiation. The fort of Chunar, near Kashi, was the land of his spiritual practice. It is said that the construction of Chunar fort is also associated with the name of Maharaja Bhartrihari. When the proposal for the presentation of this theatrical adaptation came before the Government of Madhya Pradesh, my first suggestion was that it should be organized in Kashi. Mohan Yadav said, ‘Among the artists of the event, some are doctors, some are engineers’ Mohan Yadav said, “The trio of three brothers became famous, the third one belongs to Vikramaditya's brothers. We are becoming familiar with that period of generosity and bravery. Which is happening today in the Prime Minister's constituency. This event is strengthening the development and natural relations between the two states. Among the artists of this event, some are doctors, engineers, who are dedicated to Vikramaditya.”

stories.title: Lions Simba Sultan await their 'bride' in Etawah Safari:Year-long search for a mating partner yet to yield success
stories.summary: The search for a suitable “bride” for Etawah Safari Park’s nine-and-a-half-year-old Asiatic lions Simba and Sultan has turned into a long-running tale. For nearly one-and-a-half years, efforts have been underway, but the royal bachelors are still waiting. Now, the safari management has renewed hope by initiating steps to bring a lioness named Sudha from Rohtak Zoo in Haryana. Born to be stars, now ready to settle According to Safari Director Dr Anil Kumar Patel, Simba and Sultan were born in October 2016 to lions Manan and Jessica. Over the years, the duo has grown into the main attractions of the safari, drawing visitors with their majestic presence. Now fully grown, the focus has shifted from fame to family, with plans to expand their lineage. Why the in-house match didn’t work Interestingly, the lionesses already present in the safari are siblings of Simba and Sultan. This makes breeding within the park impossible, forcing authorities to look beyond their territory. Bringing in a new lioness has now become essential to ensure the next generation of Asiatic lions at the safari. Sudha, the likely bride-to-be The spotlight is now on Sudha, a lioness from Rohtak Zoo, who is emerging as a strong contender. Talks are progressing, and if all goes as planned, she could soon arrive in Etawah. In exchange, a male lion named Vishwa, born at the safari on World Lion Day in 2022, will be sent to Rohtak. A bride with experience matters Sudha is no stranger to motherhood, having delivered cubs twice earlier. This has raised optimism among officials that she will be able to successfully breed in Etawah as well. However, before finalising the move, her health will be thoroughly checked, with samples to be tested at IVRI Bareilly and NCBS Bengaluru. Matchmaking needs official approvals The transfer process will only be completed after approval from the Central Zoo Authority in New Delhi. Meanwhile, the safari management is also in touch with other zoos, including Sakkarbaug Zoo in Gujarat and Rajgir Zoo in Bihar, to explore more options. Past promises, present hopes About a year and a half ago, Gujarat had assured the availability of a lioness, but the plan did not materialise. Since then, the search has continued across states. Officials remain hopeful that Simba and Sultan will soon find their long-awaited companion, strengthening both their family line and the safari’s appeal.

stories.summary: UP Politics: लखनऊ में सपा के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष अखिलेश यादव की अध्यक्षता में आगामी विधानसभा चुनाव की तैयारियों को लेकर एक महत्वपूर्ण बैठक हुई। इस बैठक में पार्टी के जिलाध्यक्षों और अन्य पदाधिकारियों को कई सख्त निर्देश दिए गए। अखिलेश यादव ने जिलाध्यक्षों को साफ चेतावनी दी कि वे किसी भी व्यक्ति को टिकट दिलाने का ठेका न लें। उन्होंने कहा कि अगर किसी जिलाध्यक्ष के खिलाफ ऐसी कोई शिकायत आई, तो पार्टी में उसकी खैर नहीं होगी। अखिलेश यादव ने यह भी स्पष्ट किया कि अगर कोई जिलाध्यक्ष खुद चुनाव लड़ना चाहता है, तो उसे पहले चुपचाप अपने जिलाध्यक्ष पद से इस्तीफा दे देना चाहिए। इस्तीफा देने के बाद उसे उच्च कमान को सूचित करना होगा। उसके बाद ही पार्टी इस पर विचार करेगी। उन्होंने साफ कहा कि कोई भी जिलाध्यक्ष खुद को प्रत्याशी घोषित न करे।

stories.title: Shiksha Mitras in UP to receive ₹18,000 starting this month:CM Yogi announces hike in honorarium for instructors
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath launched the ‘School Chalo Abhiyan’ from Varanasi at 10 am on Saturday. He personally placed school bags on the shoulders of children at a government school in Shivpur, distributed gifts and books, and enquired about their well-being. He later served food to the children himself. Addressing the programme, the CM attacked the Samajwadi Party government. He said that before 2017, education was not on the government’s agenda. Their people encouraged cheating so that studies would not take place in schools. Such stop-gap arrangements cannot help society progress. Adjustment of Shiksha Mitras was cancelled on July 25, 2017 The appointment of Shiksha Mitras in Uttar Pradesh began in 2001. During the Samajwadi Party government in 2013–14, they were adjusted as assistant teachers. Those who were not adjusted filed a petition in the Allahabad High Court. On September 12, 2015, the High Court ordered the cancellation of this adjustment. The state government challenged it in the Supreme Court, which, on July 25, 2017, upheld the decision and cancelled the adjustment. Reverted from assistant teachers to Shiksha Mitras Following the Supreme Court’s order, around 1.72 lakh assistant teachers were reverted to Shiksha Mitras. Their salary dropped from ₹50,000 to a monthly honorarium of ₹3,500. This led to large protests in Lucknow by Shiksha Mitras from across the state. After the protest, the government increased the honorarium from ₹3,500 to ₹10,000 per month. It also announced 68,500 assistant teacher posts, giving Shiksha Mitras priority in recruitment. They were given age relaxation and 25 bonus marks. Later, in 2019, 69,000 assistant teacher posts were announced, again with benefits for Shiksha Mitras. Over 13,000 Shiksha Mitras became assistant teachers through these recruitments. BJP government promised a solution in 2017 There are around 1.42 lakh Shiksha Mitras in state-run schools. The teacher-student ratio should ideally be 1:30, but due to their presence, it is about 1:22. Education Minister Sandeep Singh said there is currently no need for new assistant teacher recruitment. Honorarium for instructors doubled in 2017, but not implemented In 2017, instructors’ honorarium was increased from about ₹9,000 to ₹17,000, but the decision was not implemented after the change in government. Instructors moved the Lucknow bench of the High Court. A single bench ordered payment of ₹17,000 with 9% interest. The state challenged it, and a division bench allowed payment for only one year. The matter then reached the Supreme Court. On February 5, the Supreme Court dismissed the state’s appeal against the hike and ordered that instructors should not be removed from service. The court also stated that even after the contract period ends, their jobs will continue, as they have been working for over 10 years. It directed that the ₹17,000 honorarium be implemented from 2017. CM launches ‘School Chalo Abhiyan’ from Varanasi The Chief Minister launched the campaign at a government school in Shivpur, Varanasi, at 10 am. He personally gave school bags, gifts, and books to children, enquired about their well-being, and later served them food. He also criticised the previous Samajwadi Party government, saying education was not a priority before 2017 and copying in exams was encouraged, which hindered social progress. Before the event, the CM visited Kaal Bhairav temple and later offered prayers at Kashi Vishwanath temple following proper rituals. Key Points from CM’s Address 1. Over ₹80,000 crore spent on school education Yogi said that more than ₹80,000 crore is being spent on school education in Uttar Pradesh, and results must reflect this investment. Funds have been allocated in the current budget for Kasturba Gandhi schools, where they did not exist earlier. Education in these schools earlier went only up to Class 8, after which girls dropped out. The government has decided to extend this up to Class 12. 2. Dilapidated schools before 2017 He recalled that when his government came to power in 2017, the ‘School Chalo Abhiyan’ was launched on 1 July. Before that, he had visited several districts and seen the poor condition of basic education buildings. He visited a school where the principal said student numbers were declining and had dropped below 10. He was told children lacked interest in studies. The CM responded by asking whether it was the children lacking interest or the teachers lacking the will to teach. He said it is the responsibility of educators to spark curiosity among students. 3. Education key to social and economic equality Yogi said that social and economic equality can only be achieved through education. Earlier, the school dropout rate had crossed 19%, but it has now come down to 3%. The aim is to bring it down to zero. He said education is not just about degrees or certificates, but about instilling values and guiding individuals on the right path. This responsibility has been entrusted to teachers, and if fulfilled properly, it will benefit both society and the nation. 4. 1.36 lakh schools upgraded with facilities He said ‘Operation Kayakalp’ has achieved new heights, and even NITI Aayog has recognised it as a success story in education. Under this initiative, over 1.36 lakh schools have been equipped with facilities. Through ‘Operation Nipun’, children’s curiosity towards learning has increased. He cited an example of a school he revisited after three years, where student strength had grown to over 250, and the principal was selected for the President’s Award. 5. Earlier, over 60% girls walked barefoot The CM said that before 2017, more than 60% of girls walked barefoot and had only one worn-out dress, irrespective of weather conditions. Boys were in a similar situation. He said that now, under the “double engine” government, all children in basic education receive two sets of uniforms, school bags, books, shoes, and socks free of cost. Funds will be transferred to parents’ accounts in two phases after the admission process begins post 15 April and 15 July. 6. ‘I still touch my teachers’ feet’ Yogi told teachers that they have been entrusted with shaping the nation’s future. If they fulfil this responsibility honestly, they will be respected throughout their lives. He said he still touches the feet of his teachers whenever he meets them, out of respect. He emphasised that teachers not only provided education but also introduced him to knowledge, which is why he continues to honour them. He added that such values must be instilled in children. He also mentioned that two CM Composite Schools have been established in every district in the first phase, and provisions have been made in the budget for two more, so that children can receive modern education from pre-primary to Class 10–12 within a single campus.
