stories.title: The battle of promises and bigger promises: Decoding manifestos of parties in Kerala fray
stories.summary: Kerala's 2026 elections are a promise war. LDF, UDF, and NDA offer welfare, jobs, and growth. Welfare is now a baseline. Parties compete on scale and delivery. Voters seek sustainability and governance. Promises target all sections. Implementation is the real test amid fiscal challenges. This election is a referendum on competing models.

stories.summary: A 5.9 magnitude earthquake originating in Afghanistan's Jurm jolted Delhi-NCR and northern India on Friday evening. Residents across Jammu and Kashmir, Delhi, and surrounding areas felt the tremors and evacuated their homes. Fortunately, no injuries or property damage have been reported thus far in this developing situation.

stories.summary: BJP released its Tamil Nadu candidate list, excluding K Annamalai. An Iranian oil tanker rerouted to China due to payment issues. A French ship crossed Hormuz, hinting at changing Iran-France relations. Bhagwant Mann defended Raghav Chadha's removal from a Rajya Sabha post. Yuvraj Singh apologized for his father's remarks to Kapil Dev and MS Dhoni.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu elections: Why Annamalai missed BJP candidate list - alliance over leader?
stories.summary: K Annamalai's absence from the BJP's candidate list for the Tamil Nadu assembly elections has sparked speculation. Despite being sidelined, Annamalai pledged to support all NDA candidates aiming for a significant victory. His removal as state president and subsequent marginalization are linked to alliance dynamics with AIADMK and caste considerations.

stories.title: Boy claims he was a woman who died in a fire, details later match real case from decades ago
stories.summary: A young boy in Ohio claimed memories of a past life as a woman who died in a Chicago fire, later identifying details that appeared to match a real victim. The case, featured on television, drew attention for its specificity. While unexplained, it reflects a broader pattern of similar childhood accounts studied by researchers into reported past-life memories.

stories.title: France no longer hostile nation? After Macron snubs Trump, Iran allows ship to pass Hormuz
stories.summary: A French-owned container ship, the Kribi, crossed the Strait of Hormuz, potentially signaling a shift in Iran's view of France following President Macron's criticism of US policy. Macron rejected military intervention to reopen the strait, advocating for negotiations instead. The vessel's change of destination to "Owner France" may have signaled its nationality to Iranian authorities.

stories.title: What led an India-bound Iranian crude tanker to reroute to China
stories.summary: A US-sanctioned tanker carrying Iranian crude oil, initially bound for India, has rerouted to China. Payment issues appear to be the primary driver for this change, as sellers are reportedly tightening credit terms. This development highlights the ongoing challenges in facilitating Iranian oil trade, even with temporary US sanctions waivers.

Kerala assembly polls: Congress leader Ramesh Chennithala eyes chief minister post, awaits party's call
stories.summary: Congress leader Ramesh Chennithala stated that the party leadership will decide on the chief ministerial face for the 2026 Kerala Assembly elections, emphasizing his long-standing relationship with the Nehru family. He expressed confidence in the UDF's victory, highlighting their comprehensive manifesto and criticizing the LDF government's performance over the past decade.

stories.title: Japan-led mission uncovers asteroid with all 5 ‘letters’ of DNA, breakthrough for understanding life’s origins
stories.summary: Analysis of samples from the asteroid Ryugu has revealed all five nucleobases essential to DNA and RNA, strengthening evidence that life’s chemical building blocks are widespread in space. While not proof of extraterrestrial life, the finding suggests asteroids could have delivered key ingredients to early Earth, offering new insight into how life’s fundamental chemistry may emerge across the universe.

stories.title: 'Ghar wapsi will take place soon': All India Imam Organisation chief says PoK will be reintegrated with India
stories.summary: Chief Imam Umer Ahmed Ilyasi expressed confidence that Pakistan-Occupied Kashmir will soon rejoin India, citing the desire of its people and the positive developments in Jammu and Kashmir post-Article 370 abrogation. He highlighted a transformed Kashmir with increased prosperity and tourism, urging continued visits despite past incidents.

stories.title: 'People not ready to vote for you': Kanimozhi targets NDA during campaign in Tamil Nadu's Madurai
stories.summary: DMK MP Kanimozhi asserted that Tamil Nadu voters are backing the Secular Progressive Alliance over the BJP-led NDA, citing the DMK's commitment to protecting Tamil people's future. She highlighted the alliance's policy-based approach and the government's fulfillment of welfare promises, including increased financial assistance for women.

'He should resign first': Mamata targets PM Modi over voter list row in Bengal polls
stories.summary: West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee launched a sharp attack on PM Modi, demanding his resignation if infiltrators are on voter lists, as she questioned the electoral roll challenges. She also blamed AIMIM and ISF for the Malda judicial officers' gherao, accusing Congress and BJP of instigation.

Earlier, Iran's Revolutionary Guards had threatened US tech giants like Microsoft and Google, accusing them of aiding US strikes and acting as spies.

stories.title: Oil, LNG supplies: Top Russian official Manturov signals fuel support for India during Middle East crisis
stories.summary: Russia's Deputy Chairman Denis Manturov highlighted a deepening energy partnership with India, stating Moscow can ramp up oil and LNG supplies amid the Middle East crisis. The visit also confirmed increased fertilizer supplies and ongoing collaboration in nuclear energy, alongside discussions on expanding industrial, space, and technological cooperation.

stories.title: Soft PR, 'samosa' swipe: How Arvind Kejriwal's 'soldiers' justified Raghav Chadha's 'demotion' in Rajya Sabha

Senior colleagues, including Delhi AAP chief Saurabh Bharadwaj, defended the decision, accusing Chadha of prioritizing "soft PR" over confronting the government and failing to raise crucial national and Punjab-specific issues.

stories.title: Bridge for bridge: Iran lists 7 Gulf targets after Karaj strike
stories.summary: Following US-led strikes on a key bridge near Tehran, Iran is signaling potential retaliation across the Gulf. The attack, confirmed by President Trump, destroyed Iran's tallest bridge, prompting Tehran to consider a "tit for tat" response. Iranian media have identified strategic bridges in the region as possible targets, indicating a widening conflict.

stories.title: India bound US-sanctioned tanker with Iranian crude reroutes to China mid-voyage
stories.summary: A US-sanctioned tanker carrying Iranian crude oil has rerouted from India to China mid-voyage due to payment concerns. This shift underscores the complexities of resuming oil trade with Iran, as financial terms and counterparty risk have become critical factors. The incident highlights ongoing challenges despite a recent US waiver.

stories.summary: Get ready for a weather change! The UAE anticipates light rain, strong winds, and rough seas next week, shifting from current fair conditions. stories.title: 'Glued to windows': How Artemis II astronauts spent their first hours on Orion en route to Moon
stories.summary: Nasa astronauts aboard the Orion spacecraft are enjoying breathtaking views of Earth as the mission successfully executed a critical engine burn to propel them towards the Moon. The Artemis II mission is progressing as planned, with all systems and crew functioning optimally during this crucial test flight.

stories.title: 'You’ve grown afraid': AAP hits back after Raghav Chadha’s direct attack on leadership
stories.summary: A public spat erupted between AAP and Rajya Sabha MP Raghav Chadha after his removal as deputy leader. Chadha claimed he was "silenced" and prevented from raising public issues in Parliament. The party, however, accused him of fearing Prime Minister Modi and hesitating to address crucial national concerns, exposing internal leadership tensions.

10 historical signs that suggest aliens exist
stories.summary: There are historical and celestial anomalies in human history that make us question what we thought we knew about how technology and the stars interacted in the past. The Giza Plateau's unmatched geodetic accuracy and the strange ‘out-of-place’ artefacts like the Antikythera Mechanism are just two examples of unexplained things from around the world. Mainstream academia often says that these kinds of accomplishments are due to lost human creativity, but the fact that these sites are so complicated logistically and mathematically lends credence to the paleocontact hypothesis.

stories.title: Dubai suspends church masses during holy week until further notice amid rising security concerns

His debut novel, ‘The Collaborator’, was a finalist for the Guardian First Book Award and the Shakti Bhatt Prize and was longlisted for the Desmond Elliott Prize. His second novel, ‘The Book of Gold Leaves’, was shortlisted for the DSC Prize and longlisted for the Folio Prize. His third novel, ‘Tell Her Everything’, won The Hindu Literary Prize. Created by Transport Accident Commission, it underscores a stark truth: survival at modern speeds is unnatural, making safer driving, infrastructure, and vehicle design the only viable path to reducing road fatalities today.

stories.title: Rs 1,717 crore lost to digital fraud in Delhi since 2023, only 10% recovered: Government
